translations.literal: Treatise 74

translations.literal: Music 6
translations.idiomatic: Music 6

sentences.zh: 樂章四筵宴舞曲大宴笳吹樂番部合奏齋

translations.literal: Musical Airs 4: banquet dance music, great-banquet reed-pipe music, and combined performance by the frontier tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter 4 of Musical Airs: banquet dance pieces, great-banquet reed-pipe music, and frontier tribal ensemble.

sentences.zh: 元旦、冬至、萬壽三大節，慶隆舞樂九章

translations.literal: For the three great festivals of New Year's Day, the Winter Solstice, and Longevity, the Qinglong celebratory dance music has nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day, the Winter Solstice, and the Longevity celebrations—the three great festivals—the Qinglong dance is accompanied by music in nine chapters.

translations.literal: Brilliant is august Qing; it received the mandate from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Resplendent is great Qing, granted Heaven's mandate.

translations.literal: Its glory extends the great fortune; may it endure for ten thousand myriad years.
translations.idiomatic: May its radiance prolong imperial fortune for ages without end.

translations.literal: Heaven opens the seasonable festival; auspicious signs appear on the terrace steps where the day-count plant grows.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven blesses this appointed festival; good omens bloom on the palace steps.

translations.literal: All the myriad states bring tribute; may the Sage's longevity reach a thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute flows from every land; long may the Sovereign live a thousand years.

translations.literal: From our forebears of old, the foundation was laid at Edo.
translations.idiomatic: From our earliest ancestors, the house was founded at Edo.

translations.literal: On Mount Changbai, a magpie bore a cinnabar fruit in its beak.
translations.idiomatic: On Changbai Mountain, a magpie carried a red fruit in its bill.

translations.literal: Like melons on spreading vines, our line has ever flourished in blessing.
translations.idiomatic: As vines bear melon after melon, our line has grown ever more auspicious.

translations.literal: Our successive ancestors were born in abundance; accumulated blessings shine anew.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor after ancestor arose in succession, heaping blessing upon renewed glory.

translations.literal: They enlarged the former domain, eastward to the very edge of the sea.
translations.idiomatic: They broadened the ancient realm until it reached the eastern sea.

translations.literal: Sage succeeds sage in unbroken line; for ten thousand ages they can continue the succession.
translations.idiomatic: Holy ruler follows holy ruler; their succession shall endure forever.

sentences.zh: 一章赫赫神功，龍飛崛起。

translations.literal: Chapter One: Illustrious is his divine merit; like a dragon he soared and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: His sacred achievement blazes forth; he rose like a dragon taking flight.

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of donning armor, he first set forth on his path of striving.
translations.idiomatic: In his thirteenth year under arms, he first struck out on the path of conquest.

translations.literal: To avenge wrongs and quell turmoil, he first captured Tümen.
translations.idiomatic: To right grievances and pacify the realm, he first took Tümen.

translations.literal: At one point of Heaven's halberd, powerful neighbors were shaken in awe.
translations.idiomatic: Where his army pointed, mighty neighbors trembled in fear.

translations.literal: The Nine Surnames crept in aggression; their traces were swept away as if by a broom.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Clans raided in secret; they were wiped clean as if swept away.

translations.literal: The five Mongol divisions came to submit to the great title.
translations.idiomatic: The five Mongol tribes came to acknowledge the imperial title.

translations.literal: Our bright armies on four routes destroyed the foe in five days.
translations.idiomatic: Our victorious forces on four fronts annihilated the enemy within five days.

translations.literal: He fixed the tripod at Liaoshen; the capital stands lofty and firm.
translations.idiomatic: He established the capital in Liaodong and Shenyang; the royal city towers secure.

translations.literal: Battle clouds showed five colors; river ice congealed by night.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious clouds of five hues appeared; the river froze overnight.

translations.literal: Heaven aided the virtuous; he rose in accord with the age's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven aided the worthy; he rose to power as destiny ordained.

sentences.zh: 二章天亶聰明，覆幬下國。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: Heaven's gift is keen intelligence; he shelters and covers the realm below.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: Heaven endowed him with wisdom; he sheltered the empire beneath his care.

translations.literal: The distant submitted and the near returned; he broadly spread civil virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Far lands bowed and near ones came home; he spread civilizing virtue far and wide.

translations.literal: From the four quarters they came to attach themselves, gathering like clouds and following like shadows.
translations.idiomatic: From every direction they rallied to his side, massing like clouds and following in his train.

translations.literal: He established the Office of Long Life and oversaw all the various duties.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Bureau of Longevity and brought every branch of government under order.

translations.literal: Then he created the national script, patterned after the writing of Jie and the graphs of Xi.
translations.idiomatic: He devised the national script, taking its forms from the traditions of Jie and the Yellow Emperor.

translations.literal: Its sounds accord with the primal tones; for ten thousand ages it shall not change.
translations.idiomatic: Its sounds harmonize with the primal notes and shall never alter through the ages.

translations.literal: Then he fixed the military regulations; pennons and banners wave full and bright.
translations.idiomatic: He established the army's regulations; banners and standards flutter in splendor.

translations.literal: Whether solid or mixed in hue, they forever secure the eight directions.
translations.idiomatic: Whether plain or bordered, they forever settled peace in every quarter.

translations.literal: He framed great designs and accomplished a great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: He laid vast plans and brought a great undertaking to completion.

translations.literal: Blessings bestowed without bound; felicity rings through a thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings granted without limit; good fortune resounds through a thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 三章佑啟哲嗣，光闡前猷。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: He aided and opened the way for a wise heir, brightly extending the plans of his forebears.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: He nurtured a wise successor and carried forward his ancestors' designs.

translations.literal: He made manifest and exalted eminent virtue, and greatly received Heaven's favor.
translations.idiomatic: He displayed supreme virtue and welcomed Heaven's abundant grace.

translations.literal: He pacified the rebellious and comforted the wavering; Korea returned in sincere allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: He soothed the disloyal and won over the hesitant; Korea submitted in good faith.

translations.literal: For generations they have served as the eastern feudatory; regulate your jade scepter and libation vessels.
translations.idiomatic: For ages they have served as the eastern vassal; keep your tribute regalia in due order.

translations.literal: Of the thirty-five commanderies, all presented their horns in submission as subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-five districts bent their foreheads to the ground in homage.

translations.literal: Westward to the Buddhist lands, through double translation envoys came as guests.
translations.idiomatic: Westward to Buddhist realms, guests arrived through layers of interpreters.

translations.literal: He washed away Ming in campaign; his army's glory shone over Qi and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned against Ming and washed it away; his armies blazed across Qi and Lu.

translations.literal: Like lightning he swept the outskirts; though he had them, he did not seize them.
translations.idiomatic: Like lightning he swept the borderlands, yet though he could take them, he did not keep them.

translations.literal: He seized territory at Song and Xing, repeatedly destroying the enemy armies.
translations.idiomatic: He overran the lands of Song and Xing, again and again annihilating hostile forces.

translations.literal: In a hundred battles, a hundred victories; thereby he gathered great merit.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred campaigns, a hundred triumphs—thus he won his greatest honors.

sentences.zh: 四章帝德廣運，昭受鴻名。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: The Emperor's virtue spreads far; he clearly received the great name.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: His virtue ranges wide; he openly received the great imperial title.

translations.literal: He founded the state and established the era-name; great Qing was forever settled.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the nation and proclaimed the reign era; great Qing was fixed forever.

translations.literal: He made close and harmonious the nine kindreds; the constant norms were duly ordered.
translations.idiomatic: He knit the nine clans in harmony and set every human relation in its proper place.

translations.literal: He honored virtue and drew the worthy near; they were his arms and legs, his heart and backbone.
translations.idiomatic: He prized virtue and cherished the worthy as his own limbs and inmost strength.

translations.literal: The three academies were established; he mirrored antiquity and exalted Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the three academies, taking antiquity as his mirror and honoring the Confucian way.

translations.literal: Suburban, altars of soil and grain, seasonal and ancestral rites—all adorned the imperial design.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices at the suburban altars and in the ancestral temple adorned the royal enterprise.

translations.literal: Ranks and orders were distributed; the six boards undertook governance.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and titles were apportioned; the six ministries carried on the administration.

translations.literal: The hundred offices were truly regulated; the myriad states had their model set aright.
translations.idiomatic: Every office was well ordered; all the realms took their standard from him.

translations.literal: His awesomeness melted the central domains; his virtue matched the azure heavens.
translations.idiomatic: His majesty subdued the heartland; his virtue matched the heavens above.

translations.literal: Reverently he received the succession without slackening; illustrious achievement and abundant merit.
translations.idiomatic: He reverently upheld the mandate without fail—grand deeds and towering merit.

sentences.zh: 五章帝授神器，統一寰瀛。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: Heaven bestowed the sacred vessel; he unified the entire realm within the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: Heaven granted the sacred regalia; he united all the world within the seas.

translations.literal: He cut down and extinguished the great rebels; heaven and earth were borne clean.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed the great rebels until heaven and earth were cleansed.

translations.literal: Once he donned martial garb, it was like sweet rain, like timely rain.
translations.idiomatic: The moment he took up arms, blessing fell like gentle, timely rain.

translations.literal: He greatly announced the completion of arms and became lord of spirits and men.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed the completion of his martial task and became sovereign of gods and men.

translations.literal: He personally attended to great affairs of state, rectifying discipline and ordering the fundamental norms.
translations.idiomatic: He personally governed great affairs, tightening discipline and setting the realm in order.

translations.literal: He instituted rites and composed music, clearly displaying the canonical constants.
translations.idiomatic: He established ritual and composed music, proclaiming the enduring standards of the state.

translations.literal: He accepted remonstrance and employed the worthy; careful in small matters, he pondered what lay far ahead.
translations.idiomatic: He welcomed counsel and entrusted the worthy, heedful in small things and far-sighted in great ones.

translations.literal: He fixed the laws and reduced punishments; for ten thousand ages his statutes hang down.
translations.idiomatic: He codified the laws and tempered punishments, leaving statutes for all time.

translations.literal: He could be diligent, he could be frugal; with loyalty and generosity he opened the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Industrious and frugal, he founded the dynasty in loyalty and steadfast virtue.

translations.literal: The bright mandate was renewed; in reverent diligence he upheld himself.
translations.idiomatic: The mandate was made new; he held himself to unremitting care.

sentences.zh: 六章聖神建極，道冠百王。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: The sage and divine established the supreme norm; his Way crowns the hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: The sacred sovereign set the highest standard; his Way surpassed every king of old.

translations.literal: For sixty-one years, fortune and the throne endured long.
translations.idiomatic: For sixty-one years his reign and blessing endured.

translations.literal: Heaven oversaw his keen intelligence; in tender years he ruled the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven endowed him with brilliance; while still young he took the throne.

translations.literal: In filial piety he served the two palaces; his virtue towers for a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: Filial toward both palaces, his virtue towers through the ages.

translations.literal: The three scourges stirred in folly; in one stroke he swept them level.
translations.idiomatic: Three rebellions stirred; in a single campaign he swept them away.

translations.literal: The sea's turmoil was forever stilled; the waves ceased and the great whale subsided.
translations.idiomatic: The seas were pacified forever; the waves fell still and the leviathan was quieted.

translations.literal: He personally led the six armies; thrice he campaigned in the desert.
translations.idiomatic: He led the six armies in person and thrice campaigned beyond the desert.

translations.literal: By awe he made them reverent, by kindness he won their hearts; he uprooted the stubborn and upheld the weak.
translations.idiomatic: His majesty inspired awe and his grace won hearts; he uprooted the stubborn and raised up the weak.

translations.literal: The achievements and merit of Yu; the seasonal tours of the ordinances of Shun.
translations.idiomatic: His feats matched those of Yu; his tours followed the model of Shun.

translations.literal: Throughout heaven's reach and the land's extent, none failed to honor and draw near.
translations.idiomatic: Across the breadth of heaven and earth, all honored and drew near to him.

sentences.zh: 七章惟天行健，神聖則之。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Only the Way of Heaven is vigorous; the sage and divine take it as their model.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: As Heaven's course is strong and unceasing, the sacred sovereign took it as his model.

translations.literal: He mastered learning and labored in government; he was ruler and he was teacher.
translations.idiomatic: He mastered the classics and toiled in governance, both sovereign and teacher to his people.

translations.literal: Against idleness he took his admonition; at night he dressed, at dusk he took his meal.
translations.idiomatic: He made 'no slackening' his watchword, rising before dawn and eating after dusk.

translations.literal: Alone he bore care and toil, pacifying these myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: He alone bore the realm's burdens and brought peace to every land.

translations.literal: Civil patterns were warp, martial strength was woof; the earth was level and Heaven's work complete.
translations.idiomatic: Culture was the warp and arms the woof; earth was leveled and Heaven's work fulfilled.

translations.literal: In central harmony he established the supreme pole; jade resounded and metal rang.
translations.idiomatic: He stood at the center in perfect harmony; his virtue rang clear as jade and bronze.

translations.literal: For ten thousand myriad years, behold his glory and spread his blazing fame.
translations.idiomatic: For endless ages may we behold his glory and proclaim his blazing renown.

translations.literal: Revering Heaven and laboring for the people, he embodied the primal origin and became the wise.
translations.idiomatic: Revering Heaven and toiling for the people, he embodied the cosmic origin and ruled as sage.

translations.literal: Heaven's mirror is greatly manifest; may succeeding kings be cautious and reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's judgment shines clear; may every king who follows walk in reverent care.

translations.literal: Take the august ancestors as your model; may the imperial fortune flourish far.
translations.idiomatic: Model yourselves on the imperial ancestors; may the throne prosper forever.

sentences.zh: 八章瑤圖炳煥，六合雍熙。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: The jade chart blazes bright; the six directions are harmonious and prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: The imperial design shines forth; all within the six directions lives in harmony.

translations.literal: Stars shine and clouds glow; wind and rain come in season.
translations.idiomatic: Stars shine and clouds gleam; wind and rain arrive in their proper seasons.

translations.literal: He gathered in auspicious blessings; the jade candles were harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered every blessing; the four seasons ran in perfect harmony.

translations.literal: Governance misted with imperial wind; the Way's radiance illumined the imperial registers.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial grace suffused the realm; the Way's light shone upon the throne's destiny.

translations.literal: Eastward it spread gradually, westward it was draped over; north was harmonized, south was attuned.
translations.idiomatic: It spread east and covered west; the north was soothed and the south brought into accord.

translations.literal: By ladder-ships and by oceangoing craft, tribute and gifts all arrived at the steps of Yao.
translations.idiomatic: By land and sea, tribute and gifts all reached the imperial stair.

translations.literal: The sun rises and the moon is constant; the myriad realms bow and receive blessing.
translations.idiomatic: As the sun rises and the moon endures, all the world bows and shares in blessing.

translations.literal: They beat the clods and sing in the streets; they shout toward Song and offer splendid blessings.
translations.idiomatic: The people beat the earth in joy and sing in the streets; they hail long life with resounding praise.

translations.literal: Orderly is the grand ceremony; vast is the sound of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The grand rites proceed in stately order; praise resounds on every side.

translations.literal: Continuing the blessings of the successive ancestors, may ascending peace be celebrated forever.
translations.idiomatic: Carrying on our ancestors' blessing, may rising peace be celebrated forever.

translations.literal: Nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，太上皇筵宴，慶隆舞樂九章

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, at the Retired Emperor's banquet, the Qinglong dance music has nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1, at the banquet for the Retired Emperor, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in nine chapters.

translations.literal: Great is the Retired Emperor; splendid blessing comes from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Great is the Retired Emperor; radiant fortune descends from Heaven.

translations.literal: His reign-era completed the full cycle of jia; auspicious seats revolve in turn.
translations.idiomatic: His reign completed a full sixty-year cycle; blessings return in unending round.

translations.literal: In the bingchen year he began the year; the precious mandate he personally received.
translations.idiomatic: In the bingchen year the new reign began; he personally received the sacred mandate.

translations.literal: Heaven's compassion silently guided; the martial ways of the ancestors he reverently continued.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's grace guided him in silence; he reverently carried on his ancestors' martial legacy.

translations.literal: From the beginning the primal source was in accord; he did not exceed the records of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: From the outset he matched the founding mandate and never surpassed the measure of his forebears.

translations.literal: A worthy heir was born and bestowed; greatly he received the ancestral sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He raised up a worthy heir and passed on the ancestral rites in full.

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring, he properly opened the renewal of radiance.
translations.idiomatic: On the first morning of spring he solemnly inaugurated a new era of glory.

translations.literal: In the great court the transfer was given and received; blessings were extended without bound.
translations.idiomatic: In the great hall the mandate was handed on; blessings flowed without limit.

translations.literal: With singleness of purpose he held the center; the heart's transmission he reverently kept.
translations.idiomatic: Holding fast to singleness and the mean, he reverently preserved the teaching passed heart to heart.

translations.literal: He may be compared with Yu and Shun; for generations he ascended to benevolence and longevity.
translations.idiomatic: He stands beside Yu and Shun; age after age he rose toward benevolent long life.

sentences.zh: 一章維聖握符，祗嚴昭事。

translations.literal: Chapter One: The sage alone holds the tally; reverently and solemnly he makes manifest his service.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: The sacred sovereign holds Heaven's mandate and reverently performs every rite.

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn is the great altar; earnestly he upholds the rites of the Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn stands the great altar; faithfully he honors the rites of old.

translations.literal: At the southern oracle he took his place; whatever was undertaken, he personally performed.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern altar he took his station; for every rite he was present in person.

translations.literal: He prayed at the offering of the new grain and divined the harvest; he sacrificed at the rain rite and read the dragon omen.
translations.idiomatic: He prayed at the new-grain offering and divined the harvest; at the rain sacrifice he read the dragon signs.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending before the spirits, in pure sacrifice the fragrance spread forth.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended and descended before the spirits; pure offerings rose in fragrant blessing.

translations.literal: The four seasons were evenly harmonized; the hundred spirits rejoiced and received.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons ran in harmony; the hundred spirits delighted in his offerings.

translations.literal: Rain and sunshine, cold and warmth; winds came and seasons were timely.
translations.idiomatic: Rain and shine, cold and heat, winds and seasons all came in their proper time.

translations.literal: The eight marks he reverently kept in mind; the nine realms were richly prosperous and bright.
translations.idiomatic: He reverently pondered the eight virtues; the nine domains flourished in radiant peace.

translations.literal: His years increased to the highest age; without slackening he grew ever more devout.
translations.idiomatic: His years mounted to the highest age, and he grew only more devout, never slackening.

translations.literal: Abundantly he received many blessings; gathered responses multiplied in profusion.
translations.idiomatic: He richly received Heaven's blessings; responses gathered and multiplied on every side.

sentences.zh: 二章謨烈顯承，福基萬億。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: His plans and blazing merit shine forth in succession; the foundation of blessing is ten thousand millions.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: His designs and glorious deeds shine on; the foundation of blessing is beyond measure.

translations.literal: Facing and responding to Heaven above, rising fragrance clearly reaches.
translations.idiomatic: He faced Heaven in reverence; rising incense clearly reached on high.

translations.literal: Like broth on the wall he expressed his longing; the constant instructions he took as model and revered.
translations.idiomatic: He yearned for the ancestors as if seeing them on the wall; he honored their enduring teaching as his model.

translations.literal: Rising at dawn, cautious and wary; the precious registers he opened and searched.
translations.idiomatic: Each dawn he rose in wary care and studied the precious records of the realm.

translations.literal: Four times he came to the secondary capital; at the Pearl Mound he paid his visit.
translations.idiomatic: Four times he came to the eastern capital and paid homage at the imperial tombs.

translations.literal: The founding structure was arduous; he looked back in remembrance to the opening of the state.
translations.idiomatic: He recalled the hardships of founding the realm and kept the founding age ever in mind.

translations.literal: His awe was proclaimed by bow and arrow; his transforming influence made caps and robes reverent.
translations.idiomatic: His might was proclaimed in arms; his transforming rule made all the realm orderly.

translations.literal: Reverently he followed the former canons, saying he would be earnest and not forget.
translations.idiomatic: He reverently followed the ancient statutes and vowed never to forget them.

translations.literal: Generation after generation, line upon line; bright is the succession of the heir's service.
translations.idiomatic: Line upon line, generation after generation—bright is the heir who carries on the throne.

translations.literal: For ten thousand ages, may this blessing and fortune be granted.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years may this blessing be bestowed.

sentences.zh: 三章聖人敕政，綜攬萬幾。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: The sage charged with government comprehensively grasped the myriad affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: The sage directed the state and took every matter of governance in hand.

translations.literal: Utmost sincerity, long enduring; day by day he was diligent without cease.
translations.idiomatic: His sincerity was deep and enduring; day after day he toiled without rest.

translations.literal: Reverence is the sign of longevity; vigor is the substance of Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Reverence was the sign of long life; vigor was the strength of Heaven within him.

translations.literal: He penetrated and illumined the eight borders; he roused his spirit through ten divisions of the day.
translations.idiomatic: He saw clearly to every corner of the realm and labored through every hour of the day.

translations.literal: With cinnabar brush he annotated memorials; on the red steps he received the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: With vermilion brush he marked memorials; on the crimson steps he received his ministers.

translations.literal: He encouraged agriculture and trod the sacred field; he spread righteousness on inspection tours.
translations.idiomatic: He urged farming and plowed the sacred field; he toured the realm to spread righteous rule.

translations.literal: He surveyed and planned dikes and embankments, along the rivers and along the sea.
translations.idiomatic: He surveyed dikes and embankments from the rivers to the sea.

translations.literal: He practiced arms and trained in diligence; to the feudatories he bestowed and proclaimed harmony.
translations.idiomatic: He drilled in arms and trained in diligence; to the frontier domains he granted grace and peace.

translations.literal: Singleness without end; thereby he sought great years.
translations.idiomatic: His singleness of purpose never ceased; thus he won long life.

translations.literal: In constancy and permanence he preserved great peace; in former records, who could shoulder comparison?
translations.idiomatic: He preserved peace through steadfast constancy; no record of old can match him.

sentences.zh: 四章民應如草，聖澤如春。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: The people responded like grass; the sage's grace was like spring.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: The people answered like grass in the wind; the sovereign's grace was like spring.

translations.literal: The great balance silently operated; throughout the universe all shared in benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: The great cosmic balance worked in silence; all within heaven and earth shared his benevolence.

translations.literal: Five times he exempted the poll tax and grain levies; thrice he remitted the granary rice.
translations.idiomatic: Five times he remitted the poll tax and grain dues; thrice he waived the granary levies.

translations.literal: He canceled arrears and eased collections; grace penetrated to flesh and marrow.
translations.idiomatic: He canceled debts and eased taxes until his grace reached the people's very bones.

translations.literal: Then he consulted on planting and harvest, extending it throughout the domains.
translations.idiomatic: He inquired into planting and harvest and spread care to every corner of the realm.

translations.literal: When remote corners sent word, great gifts and vast bestowals followed.
translations.idiomatic: When distant regions sent appeals, he answered with lavish relief.

translations.literal: The people's hidden woes he illumined in minute detail; officials' plans he selected for the best.
translations.idiomatic: He brought hidden popular grievances to light and chose the finest plans of his officials.

translations.literal: At the shore prisons he reversed wrongful verdicts; in comforting guidance the people relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: He reversed unjust sentences in the prisons; the people relied on his comforting care.

translations.literal: Heaven and earth covered and bore all; sun and moon shone down upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Like heaven and earth he sheltered all; like sun and moon he shone upon the realm.

translations.literal: They could not name the Emperor's power; truly they enjoyed Heaven's heart.
translations.idiomatic: The people could scarcely name his bounty; truly they enjoyed Heaven's favor.

sentences.zh: 五章聖謨廣運，文德誕敷。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: The sage's plans spread far; civil virtue was greatly diffused.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: His sacred designs ranged wide; civilizing virtue spread throughout the land.

translations.literal: The Way rose like the golden mirror; emblems were resplendent at the jade pivot.
translations.idiomatic: His Way rose bright as the golden mirror; symbols of rule shone at the jade throne.

translations.literal: Rites were rectified and charts compiled; the Poetry was ordered and the Music Bureau regulated.
translations.idiomatic: He rectified ritual and compiled canonical texts; he ordered the Odes and regulated the Music Bureau.

translations.literal: The Four Repositories were arranged in order; the seven pavilions loftily stored the books.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Treasuries were catalogued; the seven library halls majestically housed the classics.

translations.literal: At the lecture hall he composed treatises; historical mirrors were proclaimed and appraised.
translations.idiomatic: At the lecture hall he composed learned works; historical mirrors were issued and discussed.

translations.literal: At the circular bridge they gathered with drums; on carved stone the classics were set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars gathered at the imperial academy; classics were engraved on stone for all to study.

translations.literal: Writings collected three thousand; poems gathered fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand works of prose were assembled; fifty thousand poems were compiled.

translations.literal: Like the Milky Way, his compositions tower; like sun and stars they blaze bright.
translations.idiomatic: His writings tower like the Milky Way; they shine like sun and stars.

translations.literal: He transformed the people and spread instruction; grace lists were posted in linked succession.
translations.idiomatic: He cultivated the people and spread learning; lists of imperial favor followed one after another.

translations.literal: Nan wood, catalpa, jujube, and oak—fine timber flourished in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Fine timber flourished everywhere—talented men rose in splendid array.

sentences.zh: 六章皇猷赫濯，載纘武功。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: The imperial designs blaze in splendor; he continued and carried on martial achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: His imperial designs shone resplendent; he carried on the legacy of martial glory.

translations.literal: Strange regions accepted the calendar; distant borderlands followed the wind.
translations.idiomatic: Distant lands accepted the imperial calendar; far tribes followed his sway.

translations.literal: The Huai tribes and the Muslim frontier—Heaven's halberd pointed again and again.
translations.idiomatic: In the northwestern tribes and the Muslim borderlands, his armies struck again and again.

translations.literal: Twenty thousand on the cartographic map; the hunt grounds were thereby opened.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand leagues were mapped; the imperial hunting domains were thereby opened.

translations.literal: Jinchuan was pacified a second time; Gongbu and the Bo were leveled to the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan was pacified again; the Gong and Bo regions were brought to submission.

translations.literal: Tower ships awed and overawed; the sea peaks were pacified and settled.
translations.idiomatic: His tower ships struck terror; the coastal regions were pacified and stilled.

translations.literal: Burma, Meng, and the frontier passes; Annan, Gong, and Que submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Burma, Meng, and the frontier passes; Annam and the southern realms bowed in submission.

translations.literal: Tibet was guarded and the Panchen Lama was secure; frontier tribes turned toward the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet was secured and the lamas kept in peace; frontier tribes turned toward the imperial court.

translations.literal: Great merit was announced ten times; he raced abreast of Yu and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Ten times he proclaimed his great victories; his speed matched Yu and Tang of old.

translations.literal: The stubborn Miao in succession submitted; he continued and inherited the purple radiance.
translations.idiomatic: The recalcitrant Miao submitted in turn; he inherited the imperial purple glory.

sentences.zh: 七章范九五福，惟帝時承。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: He patterned the nine and five blessings; only the Emperor received them in season.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: He embodied the nine blessings of the Great Plan; the Son of Heaven received them in due time.

translations.literal: A hundred million years of auspicious opening; generation after generation, blessing congealed.
translations.idiomatic: Ages of good fortune opened before him; generation after generation, blessing gathered.

translations.literal: The precious seal read 'Ten Completes'; the hall inscription read 'Four Attainments.'
translations.idiomatic: The imperial seal bore the words 'Ten Perfect Victories'; the hall plaque read 'Fourfold Attainment.'

translations.literal: The jiazi cycle was reckoned and turned; the constant origin extended through change.
translations.idiomatic: The sixty-year cycle turned full round; the eternal principle unfolded through change.

translations.literal: Great opening of longevity; repeatedly he held banquets for the aged.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the feast of ten thousand years of life; again and again he held banquets for the elderly.

translations.literal: The precious repository was opened and expounded; celestial patterns were clearly proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial treasury of books was opened and explained; celestial signs were clearly proclaimed.

translations.literal: Virtue alone is the foundation; blessing alone is the accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue is the foundation; blessing is what he amassed.

translations.literal: The imperial edicts in auspicious script blazed with literary glory; the dynastic chart overflowed with celebration.
translations.idiomatic: His edicts shone with literary splendor; the dynastic design overflowed with celebration.

translations.literal: Ninefold blessings spread in abundance; the eight directions were richly ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings multiplied like the nine 'like' verses; peace reigned in every quarter.

translations.literal: The doubled wheel of radiance shone on in succession; may it illumine our imperial ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: His glory shone on from reign to reign; may it brighten our imperial rites.

sentences.zh: 八章太上立德，咸五登三。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: The Retired Emperor established virtue; he matched the Five and ascended to the Three.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: The Retired Emperor established his virtue; he equaled the Five Emperors and rose to the Three Sovereigns.

translations.literal: He exalted the title yet declined it; deep grace was evenly spread abroad.
translations.idiomatic: He accepted the exalted title yet yielded in humility; his deep grace reached everywhere alike.

translations.literal: Moving things and plants flourished; the isles of the sea were illumined and harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: All living things flourished; even the islands beyond the seas felt his harmonious rule.

translations.literal: The Son Emperor received his countenance; younger brothers came and led forth the registers.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven attended his pleasure; younger princes came bearing their credentials.

translations.literal: The source of auspiciousness grew ever broader; celebratory fortune was greatly extended.
translations.idiomatic: The fountain of blessing grew ever wider; celebratory fortune extended far and wide.

translations.literal: The jade chart recorded the age; the pearl Dipper blazed in its course.
translations.idiomatic: The jade register marked the age; the stars shone bright in their courses.

translations.literal: Pure blessing gathered in brightness; health and strength met with good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Pure blessing gathered in radiance; vigor and health met with every good fortune.

translations.literal: Radiance opened the imperial term; forever may the supreme pole be pacified.
translations.idiomatic: His glory opened a new imperial age; may the throne be secured forever.

translations.literal: The epoch met the cycle's turn; the correct year passed through unceasing labor.
translations.idiomatic: The age turned its full cycle; the correct calendar ran on through tireless care.

translations.literal: May his origin match the sage's span; long may we praise him on Mount Tai and Mount Lai.
translations.idiomatic: May his years match the sages of old; long may we sing his praise as of Tai and Lai.

translations.literal: Nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十六年，皇太后七旬萬壽，慶隆舞樂二十章

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Qianlong, for the Empress Dowager's seventieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance music has twenty chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26, for the Empress Dowager's seventieth Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in twenty chapters.

sentences.zh: 皇太后萬壽彌增，皇帝至孝以承。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's ten thousand years of longevity ever increase; the Emperor with utmost filial piety receives it.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager's long life grows ever fuller; the Emperor receives it in deepest filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 洪福同山海，歡聲率土騰。

translations.literal: Vast blessing equals mountains and seas; sounds of joy throughout the land rise up.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing vast as mountains and seas; shouts of joy rise across the realm.

sentences.zh: 一章歲當辛巳建，壽屆七旬隆。

translations.literal: Chapter One: The year stands at xinsi established; longevity reaches seventy, grand and high.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: In the xinsi year the celebration is held; her longevity reaches seventy, grand and glorious.

sentences.zh: 怡愉太平日，舞蹈遍寰中。

translations.literal: Joyful and pleased on this day of great peace, dancing spreads throughout all within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Joyful in this age of peace, dancers celebrate throughout the world.

sentences.zh: 二章太后宏溥慈仁，宮闈式維均。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The Empress Dowager's vast and broad compassion and benevolence; within the palace gates all is kept in balance.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The Empress Dowager's compassion is vast and deep; within the palace all is kept in harmony.

sentences.zh: 綿延百世澤，長此樂長春。

translations.literal: Her grace extends for a hundred generations; long may this joy of eternal spring endure.
translations.idiomatic: Her grace flows through a hundred generations; long may this springtime joy endure.

sentences.zh: 三章盛際集禎祥，祈年日正長。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: In this flourishing age auspicious signs gather; the prayer-year days are just growing long.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: In this flourishing age blessings gather; the days of prayer for good harvest grow longer.

sentences.zh: 臣民敬申輿頌，慶覃恩敷八方。

translations.literal: Officials and people reverently offer cart-loads of praise; celebration spreads and grace is distributed to the eight directions.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people reverently offer their praise; celebration and grace spread to every quarter.

sentences.zh: 四章聖節開嘉燕，雍容舞疊獻。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: On the sage festival a fine banquet opens; with dignified ease dances are layered in offering.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: On the sacred festival a grand banquet opens; stately dances are presented one after another.

sentences.zh: 允茲祺壽綏，神人共歡忭。

translations.literal: Truly here is auspicious longevity and peace; spirits and men together rejoice in delight.
translations.idiomatic: Here is blessed longevity and peace; gods and men rejoice together.

sentences.zh: 五章金鑰曈曨曉開，成行彩仗先排。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: The golden lock opens at hazy dawn; rows of colored halberds are first arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: At golden dawn the palace gates open; ranks of ceremonial guards are drawn up in order.

sentences.zh: 臣工大小陪位，會朝稱慶無涯。

translations.literal: Officials great and small take their attendant places; at the assembly court celebration is proclaimed without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Officials great and small take their places at court; the assembly celebrates without end.

sentences.zh: 六章皇帝仁孝兼至，聖母福壽同綿。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: The Emperor's benevolence and filial piety both reach the utmost; the Holy Mother's fortune and longevity are alike unending.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: The Emperor's benevolence and filial piety are complete; the Holy Mother's fortune and long life endure together.

sentences.zh: 載考古史所紀，罕得於斯盛焉。

translations.literal: Examining what the ancient histories record, rarely has such splendor been attained.
translations.idiomatic: Searching the records of antiquity, seldom has such glory been seen.

sentences.zh: 七章皞皞熙熙盛世，氤氤氳氳元氣。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Bright and thriving is this flourishing age; the primal vapor rises in fragrant clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: Bright and joyous is this golden age; the vital breath of heaven fills the air.

sentences.zh: 皇太后聖壽無疆，皇帝孝思不匱。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's sage longevity knows no bound; the Emperor's filial thoughts never fail.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager's sacred life knows no limit; the Emperor's filial devotion never ceases.

sentences.zh: 八章如日之升，如月之恆。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: Like the sun rising, like the moon constant.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: Like the rising sun, like the enduring moon.

translations.literal: Compassionate longevity stretches on, as the southern mountain is the sign.
translations.idiomatic: Her gracious long life stretches on, as Mount Nan is our sign.

sentences.zh: 九章皇帝聖治臻隆，庶匯被澤胥濃。

translations.literal: Chapter Nine: The Emperor's sage rule reaches its height; the myriad things all receive grace, each richly soaked.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nine: The Emperor's sacred rule reaches its height; every creature shares richly in his grace.

sentences.zh: 以茲悅懌聖母，允宜福壽攸崇。

translations.literal: By this the Holy Mother is pleased and delighted; truly fitting that fortune and longevity be exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Holy Mother is gladdened; rightly should her fortune and long life be exalted.

sentences.zh: 十章大孝章矣，茀祿長矣。

translations.literal: Chapter Ten: Great filial piety is manifest; blessings and emolument are long.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Ten: Great filial piety shines forth; blessings endure long.

translations.literal: Throughout heaven all rejoice; the age is joyful and at peace.
translations.idiomatic: All under heaven rejoice; the age is joyful and secure.

sentences.zh: 十一章聖時文教昌，萬匯欣解阜。

translations.literal: Chapter Eleven: In this sage age civil culture flourishes; the myriad things gladly unfold in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eleven: In this sacred age culture flourishes; all things flourish in glad abundance.

sentences.zh: 多福允受茲，清寧並悠久。

translations.literal: Many blessings are truly received here; clarity and peace endure together for long.
translations.idiomatic: Many blessings are truly received; clarity and peace endure forever.

sentences.zh: 十二章異域輸誠，稱臣奉琛。

translations.literal: Chapter Twelve: Foreign lands offer sincerity, declaring themselves subjects and presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twelve: Distant lands offer loyalty, declaring themselves subjects and bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 屬國以萬數，雲集合歡心。

translations.literal: Dependent states number in the tens of thousands; like clouds they gather, all with joyful hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Tributary states number in the thousands; they gather like clouds with joyful hearts.

sentences.zh: 十三章殊方一以平，德威既遐布。

translations.literal: Chapter Thirteen: Strange regions are all alike pacified; civil virtue and martial awe have been spread afar.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Thirteen: Distant lands are all at peace; his virtue and might have spread far abroad.

sentences.zh: 長治而久安，慈懷同增豫。

translations.literal: Long governance and long peace; compassionate care alike increases in delight.
translations.idiomatic: Long rule and lasting peace; compassionate care brings ever greater joy.

sentences.zh: 十四章回部偕來賀，德化漸以深，戴恩永無極，送喜承皇心。

translations.literal: Chapter Fourteen: The Muslim tribes together come to congratulate; civilizing influence gradually deepens; bearing grace without end, they send joy to meet the imperial heart.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fourteen: The Muslim tribes come together to celebrate; his civilizing influence grows ever deeper; bearing boundless grace, they bring joy to the imperial court.

sentences.zh: 十五章乃陟金陛兮，慶筵載陳。

translations.literal: Chapter Fifteen: Then they ascend the golden steps; the celebratory banquet is spread forth.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fifteen: They ascend the golden steps; the feast of celebration is spread.

sentences.zh: 乃展舞采兮，至德洽於無垠。

translations.literal: Then they display the dance's splendor; supreme virtue pervades the boundless realm.
translations.idiomatic: They perform the stately dance; supreme virtue reaches to the ends of the earth.

sentences.zh: 十六章鐘鼓既宿懸，和聲娛愷樂。

translations.literal: Chapter Sixteen: Bells and drums are already hung in place; harmonious sounds bring joyous and easy delight.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Sixteen: Bells and drums stand ready; harmonious music brings joyous delight.

sentences.zh: 九重進版圖，王會式增廓。

translations.literal: The ninefold palace advances the territorial maps; the royal assembly is thereby enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: The palace receives new maps of the realm; the imperial assembly grows ever greater.

sentences.zh: 十七章曰雨曰暘時若，省歲實維屢豐。

translations.literal: Chapter Seventeen: Rain and sunshine come in season; inspecting the year's harvest, it is repeatedly abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seventeen: Rain and shine arrive in season; year after year the harvest is abundant.

sentences.zh: 泰宇既安既阜，嬉遊何幸風同。

translations.literal: The great realm is both secure and rich; in play and roaming, how fortunate to share the same wind.
translations.idiomatic: The realm is secure and prosperous; in leisure and joy all share the same blessing.

sentences.zh: 十八章浹兮淪兮，沐湛恩兮。

translations.literal: Chapter Eighteen: Saturated and steeped, bathed in deep grace.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eighteen: Saturated and steeped in his deep grace.

translations.literal: The nine provinces and ten thousand states bear it more than the Yin.
translations.idiomatic: The nine provinces and every land bear his bounty more than ever before.

sentences.zh: 十九章聖母延洪康且頤，行慶施惠人無遺。

translations.literal: Chapter Nineteen: The Holy Mother extends great health and ease in nourishment; in celebration she bestows grace, leaving no one out.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nineteen: The Holy Mother enjoys great health and ease; in celebration she bestows grace on every soul.

sentences.zh: 原集多祜綏維祺，勿替引之億萬斯。

translations.literal: May she gather many blessings and peace; may it never cease, drawn forth for ten thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: May she gather every blessing; may it never end through ten thousand ages.

translations.literal: Chapter Twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twenty.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年，皇太后八旬萬壽，慶隆舞樂十八章

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong, for the Empress Dowager's eightieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance music has eighteen chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36, for the Empress Dowager's eightieth Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in eighteen chapters.

translations.literal: The Holy Mother for ten thousand myriad years—long-lived and healthy.
translations.idiomatic: Long live the Holy Mother—long in years and sound in health.

translations.literal: The Emperor has passed sixty; filial governance shines ever brighter.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor has passed sixty; his rule of filial piety shines ever brighter.

translations.literal: The transforming realm is thick with vapor; supreme harmony soars and pervades.
translations.idiomatic: The realm is steeped in transforming breath; supreme harmony fills the air.

translations.literal: All blessings completely arrive; pure good fortune is your constant.
translations.idiomatic: Every blessing has come; pure good fortune is your constant portion.

sentences.zh: 一章重光冒卯歲序新，萬壽八秩啟今辰。

translations.literal: Chapter One: Chongguang meets mao—the year's order is new; eight decades of Longevity open this day.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: A new year begins; eight decades of Longevity are celebrated this day.

sentences.zh: 景祜自茲以永，慶日引而月升。

translations.literal: Bright blessing from henceforth is eternal; celebratory days draw on as the moon rises.
translations.idiomatic: Bright fortune endures from this day; days of celebration lengthen as the moon climbs.

sentences.zh: 二章皇帝舞采，聖母燕喜。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The Emperor displays the dance's splendor; the Holy Mother feasts in joy.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The Emperor performs the stately dance; the Holy Mother feasts in delight.

translations.literal: Harmonious qi fills the circumference; fortune and emolument gather and rest.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious breath fills the realm; fortune and blessing gather here.

sentences.zh: 三章璇宮丹雘新增，卿雲糺縵交凝。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: The jade palace is newly adorned in cinnabar; auspicious clouds intertwine and congeal.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: The palace is newly adorned in red; auspicious clouds gather and blend.

sentences.zh: 瑞符翕集，如松柏之茂承。

translations.literal: Auspicious signs gather together, like the evergreen flourishing of pine and cypress.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious signs gather, like pine and cypress ever flourishing.

sentences.zh: 四章奉安輿以時邁，乃東至於岱宗。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: Bearing the palanquin, in season they set forth, then eastward to Mount Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: Bearing the palanquin they set forth in season, journeying east to Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 陟喬嶽而行禮，百神衛祐咸來從。

translations.literal: They ascend the lofty peak and perform the rites; the hundred spirits guard and bless, all coming to follow.
translations.idiomatic: They climb the sacred peak to perform the rites; the hundred spirits guard and follow.

sentences.zh: 五章普陀肇靈剎，宗乘宣祝延慈釐。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: At Putuo a numinous monastery was founded; the Buddhist school proclaimed blessings to extend compassionate order.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: A sacred monastery was founded at Putuo; prayers were offered to extend her gracious blessing.

sentences.zh: 群籓諸部長，咸來膜拜瞻威儀。

translations.literal: Chieftains of all the feudatories and tribes all came to bow and look upon the august demeanor.
translations.idiomatic: Chiefs of every tribe and domain came to bow and behold the imperial majesty.

sentences.zh: 六章敷天合歡忭，共球萬邦獻。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: Throughout heaven all join in joyous delight; tribute from the myriad states is offered.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: All under heaven rejoice together; tribute flows from every land.

sentences.zh: 玉冊揚徽稱，煇煌晉萱殿。

translations.literal: The jade book raises the emblematic title; resplendent is the Hall of Jin and Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: The jade book proclaims her honored title; resplendent is the Hall of the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 七章慶筵樂備，孫曾效舞。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: The celebratory banquet and music are complete; grandsons and great-grandsons perform the dance.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: The feast and music are ready; grandsons and great-grandsons perform the dance.

translations.literal: Composed text harmonizes with the measure; blessings are pronounced in layered succession.
translations.idiomatic: Composed verses match the rhythm; blessings are pronounced again and again.

sentences.zh: 八章壽如南山崇，福如瀛海廣。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: Longevity like the southern mountain's height; fortune like the eastern sea's breadth.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: Long life high as the southern mountain; fortune wide as the eastern sea.

sentences.zh: 運會超郅隆，亙古實無兩。

translations.literal: The age's fortune surpasses the utmost prosperity; through all antiquity there has truly been no second.
translations.idiomatic: This age surpasses all prosperity; through all history there has been no equal.

sentences.zh: 九章振振繩繩樂含飴，撙撙總總福履綏。

translations.literal: Chapter Nine: Flourishing line upon flourishing line rejoice in sweetness; gathered and orderly, fortune's path is peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nine: Generation after generation rejoices in sweetness; gathered in order, fortune's path is secure.

sentences.zh: 奉進如意肩相隨，同祝聖壽徵攸宜。

translations.literal: They present the ruyi scepter, shoulder following shoulder; together they pray that sage longevity is the fitting sign.
translations.idiomatic: They present the ruyi scepter shoulder to shoulder, together praying for her sacred long life.

sentences.zh: 十章金門詄盪開，彩仗棽麗陳。

translations.literal: Chapter Ten: The golden gate opens with resounding song; colored halberds are arrayed in splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Ten: The golden gate opens to resounding song; ceremonial guards stand in splendid array.

translations.literal: All the officials rejoice in congratulation; none fail to honor and draw near.
translations.idiomatic: All officials rejoice in congratulation; all honor and draw near.

sentences.zh: 十一章八方太平日，負戴來紛闐。

translations.literal: Chapter Eleven: On this day of peace in the eight directions, those borne and covered come in bustling throngs.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eleven: On this day of peace in every quarter, the people come in bustling throngs.

sentences.zh: 僉曰盛哉乎斯世，維申慶於萬年。

translations.literal: All say: How flourishing is this age! Celebration is proclaimed for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: All declare: How glorious is this age! Celebration is proclaimed for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 十二章湛恩汪濊，中外禔福。

translations.literal: Chapter Twelve: Deep grace is vast and overflowing; within and without, blessing and fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twelve: His deep grace overflows; within and beyond the court, blessing reigns.

translations.literal: Officials and commoners bear his virtue; over time it grows ever more earnest.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people bear his virtue; with time their devotion grows ever deeper.

sentences.zh: 十三章鴻化迪矣，昭舄奕矣。

translations.literal: Chapter Thirteen: Great transforming influence is advanced; bright and illustrious it shines.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Thirteen: His great transforming influence advances; bright and glorious it shines.

translations.literal: The multitudes and the hundred surnames are steeped in civilizing grace.
translations.idiomatic: The common people are steeped in his civilizing grace.

sentences.zh: 十四章慈訓式於九圉，維聖母之貽。

translations.literal: Chapter Fourteen: Compassionate instruction is the model within the nine borders; it is the Holy Mother's bequest.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fourteen: Her compassionate teaching is the model throughout the realm; it is the Holy Mother's legacy.

sentences.zh: 醲膏浹無外，勿替引令祺。

translations.literal: Rich moisture saturates without exception; may it never cease, drawing forth this excellent blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Rich blessing saturates all without exception; may it never cease through the ages.

sentences.zh: 十五章歲功屢告豐穰，五風十雨兆祥。

translations.literal: Chapter Fifteen: The year's work repeatedly reports abundant harvest; five winds and ten rains are omens of blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fifteen: Year after year the harvest is abundant; favorable winds and timely rains bring good omens.

sentences.zh: 荷昊穹兮錫佑，協皇心兮降康。

translations.literal: Bearing the azure heaven's bestowed aid, in accord with the imperial heart blessing descends.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven bestows its aid; in accord with the imperial heart, peace descends.

sentences.zh: 十六章遠籓內面誠殷，土爾扈特原歸我幅員。

translations.literal: Chapter Sixteen: Distant feudatories inwardly show sincere devotion; the Torghut Mongols originally returned to our territory.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Sixteen: Distant tribes show sincere devotion within; the Torghut Mongols returned to our domain.

sentences.zh: 率戶口以數萬計，呼嵩鞠鯱來如雲。

translations.literal: Leading households numbering in the tens of thousands, they hailed long life and bowed like fish, coming like clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Leading tens of thousands of households, they hailed long life and bowed low, coming like clouds.

sentences.zh: 十七章慈顏有喜安以愉，德洋恩普周寰區。

translations.literal: Chapter Seventeen: The compassionate countenance has joy, ease, and delight; virtue overflows and grace is universal throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seventeen: Her gracious face is joyful and at ease; her virtue and grace fill the entire world.

sentences.zh: 純休永永慶那居，億萬斯年樂於胥。

translations.literal: Pure blessing forever celebrates that dwelling; for ten thousand myriad years joy is shared by all.
translations.idiomatic: Pure blessing forever celebrates her dwelling; for endless ages all share in joy.

translations.literal: Chapter Eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eighteen.

sentences.zh: 道光二十五年，皇太后七旬萬壽，慶隆舞樂九章

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang, for the Empress Dowager's seventieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance music has nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 25, for the Empress Dowager's seventieth Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in nine chapters.

translations.literal: The sun rises and the moon is constant; Heaven's course never ceases.
translations.idiomatic: The sun rises and the moon endures; Heaven's course never ceases.

translations.literal: Only the Holy Mother's longevity is boundless as Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Holy Mother's long life is boundless as Heaven.

sentences.zh: 一章淵渟岳峙兮，地道有常。

translations.literal: Chapter One: Deep as a pool, lofty as a peak; the Way of Earth has its constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: Deep as a still pool, firm as a mountain; Earth's way is constant.

translations.literal: Only the Holy Mother's longevity responds to Earth without bound.
translations.idiomatic: The Holy Mother's long life matches Earth's boundless reach.

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The day-star is auspicious, the month is fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The day is auspicious, the month is fortunate.

translations.literal: Jade goblets are set forth, golden music is arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: Jade cups are set forth, golden music is performed.

sentences.zh: 動六琯之春陽，七旬之慶節。

translations.literal: The six pitch-pipes stir with spring yang; the celebratory festival of seven decades.
translations.idiomatic: The pitch pipes stir with spring's breath; the festival of seven decades is celebrated.

sentences.zh: 三章皇帝奉爵，龍袞以侑。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: The Emperor presents the cup; in dragon robes he assists the offering.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: The Emperor presents the cup, assisting in dragon robes.

translations.literal: With his left hand he touches Shun's zither; with his right he pours Yao's wine.
translations.idiomatic: With his left he touches Shun's zither; with his right he pours Yao's wine.

translations.literal: Together with all subjects within the seas, he wishes long life for the Holy Mother.
translations.idiomatic: Together with all the realm, he wishes long life for the Holy Mother.

sentences.zh: 四章聖母燕喜，悅豫且康。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: The Holy Mother feasts in joy, pleased and at ease and healthy.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: The Holy Mother feasts in joy, pleased, at ease, and in health.

translations.literal: Then he examines the celebratory canons and consults the constant statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He consults the celebratory precedents and reviews the established statutes.

sentences.zh: 覃恩闓澤，用錫祉於萬方。

translations.literal: Grace is spread broadly and favor opened; thereby blessing is bestowed on the myriad regions.
translations.idiomatic: Grace is spread far and favor opened wide; blessing is bestowed on every land.

sentences.zh: 五章萬方有慶，四海同春。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: The myriad regions have celebration; the four seas share the same spring.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: Every land celebrates; the four seas share one spring.

translations.literal: All our fine scholars, down to the common people.
translations.idiomatic: From our finest scholars down to the common people.

sentences.zh: 仰思齊之盛化，咸蹈德而詠仁。

translations.literal: Looking up to the flourishing civilizing influence of Siqi, all tread in virtue and sing of benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to her glorious example, all follow virtue and sing of benevolence.

sentences.zh: 六章和風習習，甘雨祁祁，嘉穀六穗。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: Gentle winds blow softly, sweet rains fall abundantly; fine grain bears six ears.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: Gentle winds blow, sweet rains fall; fine grain bears six ears to the stalk.

translations.literal: Auspicious wheat with double spikes.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious wheat with double ears.

translations.literal: The source of auspiciousness and thread of blessing are the Holy Mother's bequest.
translations.idiomatic: The fountain of blessing is the Holy Mother's gift.

sentences.zh: 七章萬姓香花，千衢歌舞。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: The ten thousand surnames offer incense and flowers; along a thousand streets, song and dance.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: The people offer incense and flowers; along every street, song and dance.

translations.literal: Reverently they pray for the Holy Mother to be born to receive many blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently they pray that the Holy Mother receive abundant blessing.

sentences.zh: 樂意遍八埏，歡聲騰九土。

translations.literal: Joyful intent fills the eight borders; sounds of joy rise through the nine lands.
translations.idiomatic: Joy fills every corner; shouts of celebration rise across the realm.

sentences.zh: 八章皇帝聖德，惟聖母是承。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: The Emperor's sage virtue is received only from the Holy Mother.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: The Emperor's sacred virtue comes from the Holy Mother alone.

translations.literal: The dragon pool is spring-lovely; phoenix liquor auspiciously congeals.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon pool glows with spring; phoenix wine gathers auspicious blessing.

translations.literal: Forever may compassionate blessing be granted; may it extend for a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: May compassionate blessing endure; may her years extend beyond count.

translations.literal: Nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 同治十三年，皇太后四旬萬壽，喜起舞樂二十章

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi, for the Empress Dowager's fortieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Xingqi dance music has twenty chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 13, for the Empress Dowager's fortieth Longevity celebration, the Xingqi dance was performed to music in twenty chapters.

sentences.zh: 皇太后萬壽無疆，孝思共仰當陽。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's ten thousand years of longevity knows no bound; filial thoughts together look up to the facing sun.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager's long life knows no bound; filial devotion turns together toward the throne.

sentences.zh: 多福符三祝，維天降百祥。

translations.literal: Many blessings match the three prayers; only Heaven sends down a hundred auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: Many blessings fulfill the three prayers; Heaven sends down a hundred auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 一章歲逢甲戌，恭遇四旬。

translations.literal: Chapter One: The year meets jiaxu; reverently we encounter the fourth decade.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: In the jiaxu year we reverently mark her fourth decade.

translations.literal: Throughout heaven they offer blessings; bustling and orderly in joyous procession.
translations.idiomatic: All under heaven offer blessings; the realm bustles in orderly celebration.

sentences.zh: 二章延洪綿寶籙，佳節慶長春獻升恆頌，歡聲遍九垠。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: Prolonging greatness, continuing the precious register; on the fine festival celebrating Eternal Spring, they present the Ascendant Constancy hymn; sounds of joy fill the nine bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: Greatness endures, the sacred register unbroken; at the festival of Eternal Spring they offer the hymn of lasting renewal, and joy resounds to every corner of the realm.

sentences.zh: 三章九垠溥被崇釐，大化式於璇帷。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: The nine bounds broadly receive lofty blessing; great transformation takes form within the jade canopy.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: Blessing spreads to every corner; great civilizing influence unfolds beneath the jade canopy of state.

sentences.zh: 萬姓瞻依切，千秋統緒垂。

translations.literal: The ten thousand surnames look up in close devotion; for a thousand autumns the line of succession hangs down.
translations.idiomatic: The people look up in devoted trust; her line of succession endures for a thousand years.

sentences.zh: 四章垂簾十一年，夾輔任親賢。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: For eleven years the curtain was let down; on both sides assistance was entrusted to close kin and worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: Eleven years of regency from behind the curtain, with close kin and worthy ministers at her side.

sentences.zh: 長治久安歌永賴，武功懋兮文治宣。

translations.literal: Long governance and lasting peace are sung as eternal reliance; martial achievement flourishes, ah, and civil governance is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They sing of lasting peace under her care; martial achievement flourishes and civil rule is proclaimed abroad.

sentences.zh: 五章皇躬資撫育，訓政昭嗣服。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: The imperial person is nourished by her fostering care; instructive governance illuminates the heir's service.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: The Emperor is raised under her nurturing hand; her instructive rule lights the path for his succession.

sentences.zh: 燕翼荷貽謀，鴻庥多景福。

translations.literal: Like swallows' wings he bears the bequeathed plan; vast blessing brings many bright fortunes.
translations.idiomatic: He inherits her far-reaching counsel; vast blessing brings a wealth of bright fortune.

translations.literal: Chapter Six: The living people attain fulfillment; primordial transformation is soaked through.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: The people flourish; primordial transforming power permeates all.

translations.literal: Decrease and cutting back are checked; rent arrears are eased.
translations.idiomatic: Cutbacks are halted and rent arrears are forgiven.

translations.literal: Universal joy and benefit; drunk on quintessence.
translations.idiomatic: Joy and benefit spread everywhere; the people revel as if drunk on finest wine.

translations.literal: Bright and gleaming, harmonious and grand; pleased and pleased, joyful and joyful.
translations.idiomatic: Bright harmony everywhere; joy upon joy, pleasure upon pleasure.

sentences.zh: 七章殊方如砥平，聲教既遐布。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Remote regions are level as a whetstone; civilizing instruction already spreads far.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: Distant lands lie smooth as a whetstone; her civilizing influence reaches far and wide.

sentences.zh: 建此丕丕基，慈懷信增豫。

translations.literal: This grand grand foundation is built; maternal kindness truly increases delight.
translations.idiomatic: A mighty foundation is laid; her compassionate heart truly brings ever greater joy.

sentences.zh: 八章皇帝仁孝兼隆，聖母萬福攸同。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: The Emperor's benevolence and filial piety are both exalted; the Holy Mother's ten thousand blessings are together shared.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: The Emperor excels in benevolence and filial piety; the Holy Mother shares every blessing with him.

sentences.zh: 盛世人民樂愷，清時景物照融。

translations.literal: In the flourishing age the people are joyful and at ease; in the clear season scenery and things shine and blend.
translations.idiomatic: In this flourishing age the people live in joy; in this bright season all things glow with harmony.

sentences.zh: 九章閶闔千門啟，安輿駕鳳來。

translations.literal: Chapter Nine: The celestial gates' thousand doors open; the peaceful carriage, phoenix-drawn, comes.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nine: A thousand gates of the celestial palace open wide; her peaceful carriage, drawn as by phoenix, arrives.

sentences.zh: 德暉欣普照，歡喜上春台。

translations.literal: Virtuous radiance joyfully shines everywhere; joy and delight ascend the Spring Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Her virtuous radiance shines everywhere in joy; gladness mounts the Spring Terrace.

sentences.zh: 十章鬱鬱蔥蔥氣佳，行行采仗齊排。

translations.literal: Chapter Ten: Luxuriant, verdant air is fine; row by row colored regalia stands in even ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Ten: The air is lush and verdant; row on row colored banners stand in ordered ranks.

sentences.zh: 鷺序鵷班陪位，會朝稱慶無涯。

translations.literal: In egret order and mandarin duck ranks they take accompanying places; at the congregated court celebration is proclaimed without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Officials stand in egret and mandarin ranks beside her; at court the celebration knows no end.

sentences.zh: 十一章萱室開嘉燕，萬年觴疊獻。

translations.literal: Chapter Eleven: In the daylily chamber a fine banquet is opened; ten-thousand-year cups are piled up and presented.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eleven: A splendid banquet opens in the daylily chamber; cups for ten thousand years are offered again and again.

sentences.zh: 良辰壽而康，神人共歡忭。

translations.literal: On this fine day long life and health; spirits and humans together rejoice in exultation.
translations.idiomatic: On this blessed day she is long-lived and well; spirits and mortals rejoice together.

sentences.zh: 十二章我皇舞采，聖母情怡。

translations.literal: Chapter Twelve: Our Emperor dances with colored streamers; the Holy Mother's mood is pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twelve: Our Emperor dances with colored streamers; the Holy Mother's heart is light.

translations.literal: Supreme harmony soars and pervades; blessing and emolument come thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme harmony pervades all; blessing and prosperity follow in its wake.

translations.literal: Chapter Thirteen: They present the Five Excellences; they draw near the nine kindreds.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Thirteen: The Five Excellences are performed; the nine kindreds are brought near.

translations.literal: The Ding of Unicorn is sung; great grace is bathed in.
translations.idiomatic: They sing the Ding of Unicorn; all are bathed in great grace.

sentences.zh: 本支百世感深仁，天潢一派益敦睦。

translations.literal: Root and branches for a hundred generations feel deep benevolence; the celestial ford's single lineage ever more thickens kinship.
translations.idiomatic: Root and branch feel her deep benevolence for a hundred generations; the imperial clan grows ever closer in kinship.

sentences.zh: 十四章籓王部長咸來賓，重譯殊方職貢陳。

translations.literal: Chapter Fourteen: Feudal kings and tribal chiefs all come as guests; through repeated translation distant regions present tribute duty.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fourteen: Feudal princes and tribal chiefs all come as guests; from distant lands, through repeated translation, tribute is presented.

sentences.zh: 赤子之慕抑何深，凡有血氣同尊親。

translations.literal: The red-hearted child's longing—how deep it is; all who have blood and breath alike honor her as kin.
translations.idiomatic: How deep is the people's longing for her; all who live honor her as their own kin.

sentences.zh: 十五章奔走偕來趨闕廷，鞠鯱忭舞祝遐齡。

translations.literal: Chapter Fifteen: Running together they come to hurry toward the court hall; children and minnows dance in joy praying for far-reaching years.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fifteen: They hurry together to the court; children dance for joy, praying for her long life.

sentences.zh: 錫之冠帶列籓屏，小懷大畏懍威靈。

translations.literal: Bestowed caps and belts line the frontier screens; the small cherish, the large fear, in awe of majesty and spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Caps and belts are bestowed along the frontier; small and great alike revere her majesty.

sentences.zh: 十六章皇帝治洽重熙，垂裳恭己無為。

translations.literal: Chapter Sixteen: The Emperor's governance is thorough and doubly bright; letting down the robe, he is reverent toward himself and non-active.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Sixteen: The Emperor's rule is thorough and doubly prosperous; draped in his robe he governs with reverent ease.

sentences.zh: 以茲怡悅壽母，允宜福履綏之。

translations.literal: By this he delights and pleases the longevity mother; fitting indeed are blessing-footsteps made smooth for her.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he brings joy to his long-lived mother; blessing and ease are rightly hers.

sentences.zh: 十七章大孝章矣，茀祿康矣。

translations.literal: Chapter Seventeen: Great filial piety is manifest, ah; felicitous blessing is healthy, ah.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seventeen: Great filial piety shines forth; blessing and health are hers.

translations.literal: Do not cease to draw it forth; pure blessing is long, ah.
translations.idiomatic: May it never cease; may pure blessing endure long.

sentences.zh: 十八章五風十雨兆嘉祥，頻書大有告豐穰。

translations.literal: Chapter Eighteen: Five winds and ten rains foretell fine auspiciousness; repeatedly the Great Plenty is inscribed announcing abundant harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eighteen: Five winds and ten rains portend good fortune; again and again the Canon of Great Plenty records a bountiful harvest.

sentences.zh: 盛哉斯世泰而昌，神功炳焯煥珠囊。

translations.literal: How flourishing is this age, peaceful and prosperous; divine merit shines brilliantly, brightening the pearl pouch.
translations.idiomatic: How flourishing this peaceful, prosperous age; divine merit blazes bright, adorning the jade register of state.

sentences.zh: 十九章同游化宇戴高厚，躋金陛兮介眉壽。

translations.literal: Chapter Nineteen: Together roaming the transforming cosmos, bearing heaven's height and earth's depth; ascending the golden steps, ah, offering brow-longevity.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nineteen: Together they move through the realm that heaven and earth sustain; ascending the golden steps to wish her long life.

sentences.zh: 慈顏有喜安以愉，與天地兮同悠久。

translations.literal: The compassionate countenance has joy, peaceful and pleased; with heaven and earth, ah, alike enduring long.
translations.idiomatic: Her compassionate face is joyful, serene, and pleased; may she endure as heaven and earth endure.

translations.literal: Chapter Twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twenty.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，皇太后五旬萬壽，喜起舞樂二十章

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu, for the Empress Dowager's fiftieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Xingqi dance music has twenty chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10, for the Empress Dowager's fiftieth Longevity celebration, the Xingqi dance was performed to music in twenty chapters.

translations.literal: Supreme is the feminine pole; long enduring without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme is the feminine pole; her endurance knows no bound.

translations.literal: Ah, how fine her bright virtue; together composed, it holds within magnificence.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, how fine her luminous virtue, rich with inner grace.

translations.literal: At Yao's gate blessings pile in layers; within Si's canopy auspiciousness spreads.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings pile at the gate as at Yao's court; auspiciousness spreads within her canopy as at Si's.

translations.literal: When one person has ease, ten thousand years of longevity are ever more stored.
translations.idiomatic: When she is at ease, her long life is ever more secure.

sentences.zh: 一章星麗南弧，日躔北陸。
