translations.literal: Chapter One: Stars are beautiful at the southern arc; the sun treads the northern tract.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: Stars shine at the southern arc; the sun moves through the northern tract.

translations.literal: In the crimson chamber the reed pipes fly; on the red steps the lucky plant continues.
translations.idiomatic: Reed pipes sound in the crimson chamber; lucky plants renew on the red steps.

translations.literal: The Grand Astrologer divines the clouds; Ling Lun awaits the jade tones.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Astrologer reads the clouds; Ling Lun tunes the jade pitch pipes.

translations.literal: Above and below are harmonious together; they receive from Heaven a hundred blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Above and below are in harmony; they receive a hundred blessings from Heaven.

sentences.zh: 二章天心復旦，聖節長春。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: Heaven's heart returns at dawn; the sacred festival is Eternal Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: Heaven's heart renews at dawn; her sacred day is Eternal Spring.

translations.literal: The utmost soil joins in celebration; spanning the sky they present treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Every land joins in celebration; tribute rises to the sky.

translations.literal: Lunar observances reach the outer cosmos; cloud auspiciousness is at the central palace.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar rites extend to the farthest reach; auspicious clouds gather at the central palace.

translations.literal: The age flourishes in ritual and music; feeling reaches the utmost between Heaven and humans.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual and music flourish in her age; joy links Heaven and humanity.

sentences.zh: 三章其禮伊何，璗冊璆章。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: What is that ritual? Jade tablets and tuneful statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: What is the ritual? Jade tablets and resounding statutes.

translations.literal: Phoenix-turning precious momentum; phoenix-drawn wondrous fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix banners wheel in splendor; phoenix incense drifts in wondrous fragrance.

translations.literal: Golden branches and bright gathering; jade guards and clouds spread out.
translations.idiomatic: Golden banners gleam in assembly; jade guards and cloudlike standards spread wide.

translations.literal: Solemn and harmonious, lasting joy; mugwort thrives, the aged prosper.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn harmony fills the Hall of Lasting Joy; thriving age brings ever greater prosperity.

sentences.zh: 四章其樂伊何，韶韺亮希。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: What is that music? The Shao, resounding, bright and rare.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: What is the music? The Shao, resounding, bright, and sublime.

translations.literal: Heaven's song resists with pitch pipes; cloud dances step in orderly ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's song meets the pitch pipes; cloudlike dancers move in solemn ritual.

translations.literal: Double splendor flows endlessly; the eight winds wheel and return.
translations.idiomatic: Splendor unfolds without end; the eight winds wheel and return.

translations.literal: Jade tokens and golden harmonics; the emblem of continuing sound.
translations.idiomatic: Jade tokens and golden harmony mark the emblem of enduring music.

sentences.zh: 五章福以德昌，慶因善積。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: Fortune by virtue flourishes; celebration because goodness accumulates.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: Fortune flourishes through virtue; celebration grows from accumulated goodness.

translations.literal: Reverent and solemn she presides; nearing health without satiety.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent and dignified she presides; near to health and never weary of care.

translations.literal: Instruction flows like silkworms to the observatory; breeze and radiance in the peppered rear palace.
translations.idiomatic: Her instruction flows to every quarter; grace and splendor fill the inner palace.

translations.literal: All pipes and written observances complete; tilting the curved jade, they present the model.
translations.idiomatic: Every rite and record is complete; jade tablets are offered in full observance.

sentences.zh: 六章助隆庶政，啟佑我皇。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: She assists in elevating the many affairs of government; she opens and protects our Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: She helps elevate every branch of government and guides our Emperor.

translations.literal: Quivered are mighty bow and arrow; gathered are auspicious omens, ladder-ships and river craft.
translations.idiomatic: Bows and arrows are laid away; auspicious tributes arrive by land and sea.

translations.literal: Felt-tent country immediately is put in order; island interpreters guest the king.
translations.idiomatic: Felt-tent lands settle in order; island peoples come as guests to the throne.

translations.literal: Kindness and harmony clothe everywhere; preserving awe, splendor ever more shines.
translations.idiomatic: Kindness and harmony reach every land; reverent awe makes her glory shine the brighter.

sentences.zh: 七章於維廣運，上媲昊穹。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Ah, in the vast transforming power; upward she matches the vast vault.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: In vast transforming power she rises to match the great vault of Heaven.

translations.literal: Spring nourishes, summer fosters; within the covering, without the sheltering cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Spring nourishes and summer fosters; within and without she shelters all.

translations.literal: The scented qin resolves resentment; fine jade prays for abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The scented qin eases every care; fine jade is offered to pray for abundance.

translations.literal: Ten thousand years soar in harmony; a hundred households flourish and rise.
translations.idiomatic: Harmony prevails for ten thousand years; a hundred households flourish and thrive.

sentences.zh: 八章鄧林翹秀，昆岫搜奇。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: In Deng's forest outstanding talent towers; on Kun's peaks the extraordinary is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: Outstanding talent rises like trees in Deng Forest; wondrous gifts are gathered from Kun's peaks.

translations.literal: Widely they seek the capable and righteous; offices and duties are allotted to officials and teachers.
translations.idiomatic: The worthy are sought far and wide; offices and duties are assigned to ministers and teachers.

translations.literal: The Four are clear and penetrating; the Three Residences are broadly consulted.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Ministers are clear-sighted; the Three Residences are broadly consulted.

translations.literal: Gathering ears, they advance the worthy, like the songs of the Airs and Hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Worthies are advanced as in the Gathering Ears; their praise rings like the Airs and Hymns.

sentences.zh: 九章聖人在上，席鬯綏和。

translations.literal: Chapter Nine: The sage person is above; on the mat, fragrant herb, peace and harmony are settled.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nine: The sage ruler sits above; fragrant offerings bring peace and harmony.

translations.literal: Compassionate clouds shade the far; beloved sun's radiance is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Compassionate clouds shade the distant reaches; beloved sunlight spreads in abundance.

translations.literal: Benevolent beasts return to the marsh; spirit birds rest on the branch.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent beasts return to the marshes; spirit birds rest on the branches.

translations.literal: Scholars at court rejoice; common folk in the fields sing.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars rejoice at court; common folk sing in the fields.

sentences.zh: 十章帝隆孝治，躬奉天經。

translations.literal: Chapter Ten: The Emperor exalts filial governance; personally he upholds Heaven's constant.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Ten: The Emperor exalts rule through filial piety; personally he upholds Heaven's law.

translations.literal: Fixed tassels, elevated curtain; sounding jade in the compassionate court.
translations.idiomatic: With fixed tassels before the elevated curtain, jade chimes sound in the Hall of Compassion.

translations.literal: Ritual appearance continuous; Shun's longing steaming upward.
translations.idiomatic: His ritual demeanor is unceasing; his longing for her rises like steam toward Shun's example.

translations.literal: A hundred rites have all arrived; the four seas accordingly receive them.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred rites are complete; the four seas receive them all.

sentences.zh: 十一章丕顯宗親，蕆時嘉會。

translations.literal: Chapter Eleven: Greatly manifest are the imperial kindred; at the stored season, the fine gathering.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eleven: The imperial kin are displayed in full splendor at this fine seasonal gathering.

translations.literal: Tracing the moon, viewing the stars; strung pearls pierce the beads.
translations.idiomatic: They mark the moon and watch the stars; pearls and beads are strung in order.

translations.literal: The jade source ever more deepens; jade leaves know sheltering shade.
translations.idiomatic: The jade spring runs ever deeper; the jade leaves know her sheltering shade.

translations.literal: Instruction in frugality displays reverence; in practice celebration, bestowing favor.
translations.idiomatic: She teaches frugality and displays reverence; in celebration she bestows favor.

sentences.zh: 十二章濟濟卿士，將將會朝。

translations.literal: Chapter Twelve: Numerous ministers; strongly, strongly they assemble at court.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twelve: Ministers throng the court in stately array.

translations.literal: People gaze at the red screen; Heaven looks down on the celebratory eve.
translations.idiomatic: People gaze toward the crimson screen; Heaven looks down on the night of celebration.

translations.literal: Rich writing shines with ornament; sagely filial piety is pictured in jade.
translations.idiomatic: Rich words shine with ornament; sagely filial devotion is shown in jade.

translations.literal: They call to Song, pray for splendor; praise Lu, sing of Yao.
translations.idiomatic: They shout homage to Mount Song, pray for splendor; sing praise as of Lu and Yao.

sentences.zh: 十三章亦有籓長，綴於朝儀。

translations.literal: Chapter Thirteen: There are also frontier chiefs; they are attached to the court ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Thirteen: Frontier chiefs too join the court ceremony.

translations.literal: Repeated libation treasures overflow the steps; tribute blessings crowd the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Libation treasures overflow the steps; tribute blessings crowd the courtyard.

translations.literal: Coming guests bring jade and horses; going gifts bestow gold and rhinoceros horn.
translations.idiomatic: Guests arrive with jade and horses; gifts go forth of gold and rhinoceros horn.

translations.literal: Having answered the imperial blessing, all rejoice in the great tripod.
translations.idiomatic: Having received the imperial blessing, all rejoice before the great ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 十四章帝命重申，如綸如綍。

translations.literal: Chapter Fourteen: The Emperor's command is again proclaimed, like silk cords, like imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fourteen: The Emperor's command is proclaimed again, cord upon cord of decree.

translations.literal: He encourages agriculture and bestows rent; he urges ranks and proclaims emoluments.
translations.idiomatic: He encourages farming and grants rent relief; he advances office and proclaims stipends.

translations.literal: Bright and harmonious is the Spring Terrace; spacious and lofty the Summer House.
translations.idiomatic: Joy fills the Spring Terrace; spacious ease fills the Summer House.

translations.literal: Celebratory rewards rise like clouds; sounds of joy swift as thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Celebratory rewards rise like clouds; shouts of joy roll fast as thunder.

sentences.zh: 十五章昭禮告秩，慈顏愷康。

translations.literal: Chapter Fifteen: Bright rites report the seasonal order; the compassionate countenance is joyful and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fifteen: Bright rites proclaim the season; her gracious face is joyful and at ease.

translations.literal: Revolving radiance on the jade steps; sounding joy with jade goblets.
translations.idiomatic: Radiance turns upon the jade steps; jade cups sound with joyful music.

translations.literal: Brilliant is sacred filial piety; covered in abundant blessing and flourishing peace.
translations.idiomatic: Brilliant is her sacred filial devotion; abundant blessing and flourishing peace abound.

translations.literal: The Hook and Tong stars are now bright; extended blessings are also fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: The Hook and Tong constellations shine bright; extended blessings bloom fragrant.

sentences.zh: 十六章黃屋長今，彤箴自古。

translations.literal: Chapter Sixteen: The yellow canopy endures to this day; the red admonition dates from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Sixteen: The imperial canopy endures today; her righteous teaching dates from antiquity.

translations.literal: At Guirui she became consort to Shun; at Tushan she assisted Yu the Great.
translations.idiomatic: At Guirui she became consort to Shun; at Tushan she assisted Yu the Great.

translations.literal: Her eminent virtue is brilliantly clear; repeated norms are carried down.
translations.idiomatic: Her eminent virtue shines brilliantly; norm upon norm descends through the ages.

translations.literal: With this blessing, supreme good fortune; fitting to extend distant succession.
translations.idiomatic: With supreme blessing and good fortune, her distant line is fit to endure.

sentences.zh: 十七章甲子章蔀，循環無端。

translations.literal: Chapter Seventeen: The jiazi cycle and the cyclical canopy revolve without end.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seventeen: The sexagenary cycle turns; the cyclical canopy revolves without end.

translations.literal: The Changes' diagram of Great Expansion; Fu Xi's drawing of the Former Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Changes' Great Expansion; Fu Xi's Former Heaven diagram.

translations.literal: The Jizi sections unfold blessing; the Yellow Emperor's policy adjusts the primal element.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan unfolds blessing; the primal element is tuned to harmony.

translations.literal: Only Heaven blesses the sage; here may she reign for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven blesses the sage; may she endure here for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 十八章嶟嶟五嶽，而岱之宗。

translations.literal: Chapter Eighteen: Lofty are the five sacred peaks; of them Mount Dai is chief.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eighteen: Lofty stand the five sacred peaks; of them Mount Tai is supreme.

translations.literal: Abundant are the hundred rivers; the sea contains them all.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant are a hundred rivers; the sea receives them all.

translations.literal: Yin and yang are pure and solemn; the eight directions flourish in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth are pure and solemn; every region flourishes in harmony.

translations.literal: Deep grace floods like waves; lofty years are lofty as mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Deep grace floods like waves; her noble years tower like mountains.

sentences.zh: 十九章靈貺便蕃，昌期綏茂。

translations.literal: Chapter Nineteen: Spiritual gifts are frequent and abundant; the flourishing age is peaceful and lush.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nineteen: Spiritual gifts abound; the flourishing age is peaceful and lush.

translations.literal: Imperial radiance is gathered and bright; the Mother's standard is pure blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial radiance gathers and shines; her maternal example is pure blessing.

translations.literal: Far and near are one body; great and small bow in homage.
translations.idiomatic: Far and near are one; great and small bow in homage.

translations.literal: Long life is supreme blessing; may her posterity flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Long life and supreme blessing; may her line flourish ever after.

translations.literal: Chapter Twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twenty.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，皇太后六旬萬壽，喜起舞樂二十章

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu, for the Empress Dowager's sixtieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Xingqi dance music has twenty chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20, for the Empress Dowager's sixtieth Longevity celebration, the Xingqi dance was performed to music in twenty chapters.

sentences.zh: 皇太后福壽同綿，皇帝仁孝兼全。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's fortune and longevity are alike unending; the Emperor's benevolence and filial piety are both complete.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager's fortune and longevity are unending alike; the Emperor's benevolence and filial piety are complete.

translations.literal: Heaven blesses the Holy Mother and bestows upon her a great span of years.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven blesses the Holy Mother and grants her a great span of years.

sentences.zh: 一章閼逢歲之陽，其陰在敦牂。

translations.literal: Chapter One: In the yang of the Sheti year, its yin lies in Dunzang.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: In the yang of the sexagenary year, its yin lies in Dunzang.

translations.literal: The day is supremely auspicious; the month is called excellent.
translations.idiomatic: The day is auspicious; the month is blessed.

sentences.zh: 二章王會大同，星紀五復。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The royal assembly achieves great unity; the star chronicle turns five times.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The royal assembly achieves great unity; the cycle of years turns fivefold.

translations.literal: Ten thousand states for ten thousand years, thereby to receive splendid blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand states for ten thousand years, to receive splendid blessing.

sentences.zh: 三章猗歟母儀，翼我聖主。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: How admirable the Mother's standard, she assists our sage ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: How admirable her maternal example; she sustains our sage ruler.

translations.literal: Called benevolent, called wise; truly civil, truly martial.
translations.idiomatic: Called benevolent and wise; truly civil and martial.

sentences.zh: 四章其武維何，謐謀璇幄。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: What is his martial prowess? Deep counsel in the jade canopy.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: What is his martial prowess? Deep counsel within the imperial canopy.

translations.literal: He pacifies the sacred land; his awesomeness terrifies alien customs.
translations.idiomatic: He pacifies the sacred land; his might awes foreign realms.

sentences.zh: 五章其文維何，崇儒禮賢。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: What is his civil achievement? He honors Confucianism and treats worthies with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: What is his civil achievement? He honors learning and treats the worthy with ritual.

translations.literal: Kui constellation's brilliance and literary splendor shine like the Milky Way in heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Literary brilliance shines like the Milky Way spanning heaven.

sentences.zh: 六章其智維何，明燭萬里。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: What is his wisdom? Bright illumination for ten thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: What is his wisdom? His light reaches ten thousand li.

translations.literal: Within and without are one family; palace and government are one body.
translations.idiomatic: Court and country are one family; palace and government move as one.

sentences.zh: 七章其仁維何，如湯如堯。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: What is his benevolence? Like Tang of Shang, like Emperor Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: What is his benevolence? Like Tang, like Yao.

translations.literal: He remits rents and opens the treasuries to relieve the people's toil.
translations.idiomatic: He remits rents and opens the treasury to ease the people's labor.

sentences.zh: 八章民勞休止，庶優遊止。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: The people's toil rests; the multitude may leisurely rest.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: The people's labor rests; the multitude may live at ease.

translations.literal: Though at rest, do not cease resting; seek to end the people's afflictions.
translations.idiomatic: Though the realm is at ease, he does not cease; he seeks to end every affliction.

sentences.zh: 九章自普天而率土兮，咸浹髓而淪肌。

translations.literal: Chapter Nine: From all under heaven and every land within, all are soaked to the marrow and steeped in the flesh.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nine: From heaven's reach to every land beneath, all are steeped to the marrow.

translations.literal: The sage Emperor's virtue; the Holy Mother's compassion.
translations.idiomatic: The sage Emperor's virtue; the Holy Mother's compassion.

sentences.zh: 十章茂矣美矣，薦嘉祉兮。

translations.literal: Chapter Ten: Flourishing and beautiful, they present auspicious blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Ten: Flourishing and beautiful, they present auspicious blessing.

translations.literal: Vast and imperial, pure blessing is your constant portion.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and glorious, pure blessing is hers without cease.

sentences.zh: 十一章累印若綬，颺拜稽首。

translations.literal: Chapter Eleven: Layer upon layer of seals like cords; they bow and prostrate in homage.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eleven: Seal upon seal like silken cords; all bow and prostrate in homage.

translations.literal: Songs in the fields and ballads in the streets reach even children and the aged.
translations.idiomatic: Songs in fields and streets reach even children and the aged.

sentences.zh: 十二章累譯而至，屬國以萬計。

translations.literal: Chapter Twelve: Through repeated translation they arrive; tributary states number in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twelve: Through many tongues they arrive; tributary states number in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 咸含和而吐氣，頌曰盛哉乎斯世。

translations.literal: All breathe in harmony and exhale benevolent qi; they praise: How flourishing is this age!
translations.idiomatic: All breathe harmony; they praise: How glorious is this age!

sentences.zh: 十三章大矣孝熙，聖皇之思。

translations.literal: Chapter Thirteen: Great is filial radiance, the sage Emperor's thought.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Thirteen: Great is filial devotion, the sage Emperor's care.

sentences.zh: 以天下養，永奠此丕丕基。

translations.literal: With the empire he supports her; he forever secures this vast and vast foundation.
translations.idiomatic: With all the realm he supports her; he forever secures this vast foundation.

sentences.zh: 十四章行慶施惠，湛恩汪濊，而熾而昌。

translations.literal: Chapter Fourteen: Dispensing celebration and bestowing favor, deep grace is vast and overflowing, ever flourishing, ever prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fourteen: He dispenses celebration and bestows favor; deep grace overflows, ever flourishing and prosperous.

translations.literal: Brow-longevity without harm.
translations.idiomatic: Long life without end of harm.

sentences.zh: 十五章乃鏤璆冊兮彖瑤章，乃展瓊筵兮奉玉觴。

translations.literal: Chapter Fifteen: Now he carves the fine registers and inscribes jade chapters; now he spreads the jade banquet and presents jade cups.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fifteen: He inscribes fine registers and jade chapters; he spreads the jade banquet and presents jade cups.

sentences.zh: 乃瞻金陛兮穆穆皇皇，乃奏雅樂兮喈喈將將。

translations.literal: Now they gaze upon the golden steps, solemn and august; now they perform elegant music, harmonious and resounding.
translations.idiomatic: They gaze upon the golden steps, solemn and august; elegant music sounds, harmonious and grand.

sentences.zh: 十六章琴瑟在御，鍾罄在虡。

translations.literal: Chapter Sixteen: Zithers and lutes are set for use; bells and chime-stones are on their stands.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Sixteen: Zithers and lutes stand ready; bells and chime-stones ring from their stands.

translations.literal: With resonant sound the drums are struck; with high spirit they dance.
translations.idiomatic: Drums beat with resonant sound; dancers move with soaring grace.

sentences.zh: 十七章蕩蕩八荒，惠問所翔。

translations.literal: Chapter Seventeen: Vast across the eight wild regions, benevolent inquiry flies everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seventeen: Across the eight directions his benevolent care ranges far.

translations.literal: We pray for the Holy Mother's long life; may it respond to Earth without bound.
translations.idiomatic: We pray for the Holy Mother's long life; may it match Earth's boundless reach.

sentences.zh: 十八章圜穹戴笠，徽音四塞，原聖母壽。

translations.literal: Chapter Eighteen: The round heaven wears its canopy; her fine reputation fills the four quarters; we pray for the Holy Mother's long life.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eighteen: Heaven wears its canopy; her renown fills every quarter; we pray for the Holy Mother's long life.

translations.literal: May it be boundless as Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: May it be boundless as Heaven.

sentences.zh: 十九章荷天衢，提地釐，迄於期頤。

translations.literal: Chapter Nineteen: Bearing Heaven's thoroughfare, lifting Earth's measures, reaching to the age of one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nineteen: Bearing Heaven's path, lifting Earth's blessing, may she reach a hundred years.

translations.literal: For ten thousand beings, a thousand years; may fortune's path be peaceful for her.
translations.idiomatic: For all creation, a thousand years; may fortune's path be peaceful.

translations.literal: Chapter Twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twenty.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十五年，高宗七旬萬壽，慶隆舞樂九章

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year of Qianlong, for the Gaozong Emperor's seventieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance music has nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 45, for the Gaozong Emperor's seventieth Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 皇帝萬萬壽，福如大海源。

translations.literal: The Emperor's ten thousand myriad years of longevity; blessing like the great sea's source.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand myriad years to the Emperor; blessing flows like the ocean's source.

sentences.zh: 浩元氣兮春和溫，澤洋溢兮彌乾坤。

translations.literal: Vast primal qi, spring harmony and warmth; favor overflowing fills heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Vast primal breath, spring warmth; his favor overflows and fills heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 一章歲維庚子，恭遇七旬。

translations.literal: Chapter One: The year is gengzi; reverently we encounter seven decades.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: In the gengzi year we reverently mark seven decades.

translations.literal: Great peace has its omens; grand celebration daily renews.
translations.idiomatic: Great peace has its omens; grand celebration renews day by day.

sentences.zh: 二章班禪覲後藏，十方皈依舉延企。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The Panchen Lama paid homage after Tibet; from the ten directions all come to worship, raising hopes aloft.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The Panchen Lama paid homage from Tibet; from every quarter all come to worship with raised hopes.

sentences.zh: 瑞靄集豐年，廣法輪，宗風被。

translations.literal: Auspicious mist gathers in abundant years; the Dharma wheel is widely turned; Buddhist teaching spreads.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious mist gathers in abundant years; the Dharma wheel turns; Buddhist teaching spreads far.

translations.literal: Chapter Three: At Lizheng Gate, the resounding song opens.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: At the Lizheng Gate, resounding song opens forth.

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, and great ministers bow and dance, gazing upon the imperial escort.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and ministers bow and dance, gazing upon the imperial procession.

translations.literal: Banners veil the mist; fragrance gleams brightly.
translations.idiomatic: Banners veil the mist; fragrance shines brightly.

translations.literal: The five-colored clouds are bright; incense smoke rises.
translations.idiomatic: Five-colored clouds shine bright; incense smoke ascends.

sentences.zh: 四章敬天勤民久，純德四海敷。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: Revering Heaven and laboring for the people long has he; pure virtue spreads through the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: Long has he revered Heaven and served the people; pure virtue spreads through the four seas.

sentences.zh: 皇帝壽，萬萬年，孔固南山如。

translations.literal: The Emperor's longevity, ten thousand myriad years, firmly as the southern mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's life, ten thousand myriad years, firm as the southern mountain.

sentences.zh: 五章蒙古眾台吉，青海衛拉特。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: The many Mongol taiji; the Oirat of Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: The many Mongol princes; the Oirat of Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 愛之如赤子，傾心世歸德。

translations.literal: He loves them as newborn babes; all devote their hearts and return to virtue generation after generation.
translations.idiomatic: He loves them as his own children; generation after generation devote their hearts to him.

sentences.zh: 六章土爾扈特歸順，武義金川威震。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: The Torghut Mongols return in submission; martial righteousness in Jinchuan, awesomeness that shakes.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: The Torghut Mongols return in submission; military glory at Jinchuan shakes the realm.

sentences.zh: 如天大德曰生，蹈舞揚休入覲。

translations.literal: Like Heaven's great virtue that gives life, they dance and proclaim celebration, coming to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's great virtue gives life; they dance in celebration and come to audience.

sentences.zh: 七章曼壽多福，臚歡無疆。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Vast longevity and many blessings, proclaimed joy without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: Vast longevity and many blessings; proclaimed joy knows no bound.

translations.literal: Like pine and cypress flourishing; ten thousand leaves ever verdant.
translations.idiomatic: Like pine and cypress in full leaf; ten thousand leaves ever verdant.

sentences.zh: 八章皇子及孫曾，稱觴介眉壽。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: Princes and sons, grandsons and great-grandsons, raise cups and present brow-longevity.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: Princes, grandsons, and great-grandsons raise cups and wish him long life.

sentences.zh: 祝鴻禧兮歲其有，與天地兮同悠久。

translations.literal: They pray for grand celebration in every year; may he endure as heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: They pray grand celebration year on year; may he endure as long as heaven and earth.

translations.literal: Nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十五年，高宗八旬萬壽，慶隆舞樂十八章

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year of Qianlong, for the Gaozong Emperor's eightieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance music has eighteen chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 55, for the Gaozong Emperor's eightieth Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in eighteen chapters.

sentences.zh: 皇帝萬萬壽，福如大海源。

translations.literal: The Emperor's ten thousand myriad years of longevity; blessing like the great sea's source.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand myriad years to the Emperor; blessing flows like the ocean's source.

sentences.zh: 亭育德恩普，休和暢八埏。

translations.literal: Nurturing virtue and favor universally spread; harmony and ease reach the eight borders.
translations.idiomatic: His nurturing virtue spreads far; harmony and ease reach every border.

sentences.zh: 一章歲維庚戌，恭遇八旬。

translations.literal: Chapter One: The year is gengxu; reverently we encounter eight decades.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: In the gengxu year we reverently mark eight decades.

translations.literal: Spirits and men offer blessings; splendid fortune ever advances.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits and men offer blessing; splendid fortune ever advances.

sentences.zh: 二章洞開九重，辟公呼嵩。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The ninefold palace gates open wide; lords call out long life.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The palace gates open wide; lords hail long life.

translations.literal: Auspicious light veils the mist; song and dance are together alike.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious light veils the mist; all sing and dance as one.

sentences.zh: 三章敬天勤民，歲書大有。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: Revering Heaven and laboring for the people; the year records great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: He reveres Heaven and serves the people; the year records great abundance.

translations.literal: Ten thousand years of longevity without bound; mountains and peaks enduring.
translations.idiomatic: Long life knows no bound; his years endure as mountains.

sentences.zh: 四章文光炳二曜，武烈宣萬方。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: Civil radiance shines like the two luminaries; martial glory proclaimed to the myriad regions.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: Civil brilliance shines like sun and moon; martial glory reaches every land.

sentences.zh: 義正以仁育，遐邇胥來王。

translations.literal: Righteous governance with benevolent nurturing; far and near all come as kings.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous rule nurtures with benevolence; far and near all come to court.

sentences.zh: 五章燕千叟兮嘉龐眉，賜筇帛兮拜鴻施。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: Feasting a thousand elders with fine lofty brows; bestowing bamboo cloth as they bow to the vast gift.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: Feasting a thousand elders of venerable brow; bestowing bamboo cloth, they bow to his vast gift.

sentences.zh: 臚歡介祉兮叩彤墀，群登壽兮祝蕃釐。

translations.literal: Proclaiming joy and presenting blessing as they knock upon the vermilion steps; all ascend to wish long life and pray for abundant fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaiming joy they bow upon the vermilion steps; all wish him long life and abundant fortune.

translations.literal: Chapter Six: Deep affection for the imperial lineage; bestowing robes of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: Deep care for the imperial house; bestowing robes of rank.

translations.literal: Brilliant are the five colors; close are the nine clans.
translations.idiomatic: The five colors blaze bright; the nine clans draw near in kinship.

sentences.zh: 本支百世感殊恩，歡洽群情益敦睦。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: The root and branches for a hundred generations feel extraordinary grace; joy pervades every heart and kinship grows ever more warm.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: Root and branch for a hundred generations feel his grace; joy fills every heart and kinship grows ever warmer.

sentences.zh: 七章臨雍釋菜，文教振興。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: At the Imperial Academy he presents the sacrificial offering; civil teaching flourishes anew.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: At the Imperial Academy he presents the offering; civil teaching flourishes anew.

translations.literal: Talents rejoice in nurture; they are the pillars of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Talents rejoice in nurture; they are pillars of the state.

sentences.zh: 八章輯四庫書，譽髦鼓舞。

translations.literal: Chapter Nine: He compiles the Four Repositories; eminent scholars rejoice and are inspired.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nine: He compiles the Four Repositories; eminent scholars rejoice and take heart.

translations.literal: He favors the grove of arts; above and below, past and present.
translations.idiomatic: He favors the realm of arts, spanning past and present.

sentences.zh: 九章修藏兮譯金經，廣善緣兮福群生。

translations.literal: Chapter Ten: He collates the canon and translates the golden sutras; he spreads good karma and blesses all beings.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Ten: He collates the canon and translates Buddhist scriptures; he spreads good karma and blesses all beings.

sentences.zh: 慈雲布濩兮光晶瑩，和風甘雨兮彌八紘。

translations.literal: Compassionate clouds spread broadly, light crystal-bright; gentle winds and sweet rains fill the eight cords.
translations.idiomatic: Compassionate clouds spread far, light crystal-bright; gentle winds and sweet rains fill every border.

sentences.zh: 十章籓王部長咸來賓，遐荒重譯職貢陳。

translations.literal: Chapter Eleven: Frontier princes and tribal chiefs all come as guests; distant lands through many translations present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eleven: Frontier princes and tribal chiefs all come as guests; distant lands through many tongues present tribute.

sentences.zh: 依光慕化同尊親，赤子之慕中外均。

translations.literal: They draw near his light and admire his transforming influence, honoring kinship alike; like infants they yearn for him, within and without equally.
translations.idiomatic: They draw near his light and admire his rule, honoring kinship alike; like children they yearn for him, court and country alike.

sentences.zh: 十一章安南國王趨闕廷，鞠鯱忭舞祝億齡。

translations.literal: Chapter Twelve: The king of Annam hastens to the palace court; bowing like fish, he dances in joy and prays for a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Twelve: The king of Annam hastens to court; bowing low, he dances in joy and prays for endless years.

sentences.zh: 寵以冠帶列翰屏，聲教遠暨海國寧。

translations.literal: Honored with cap and belt, he is ranked among the brush-and-ink ministers; his culture's teaching reaches far and the maritime lands are tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Honored with cap and belt, he ranks among the scholar-officials; his teaching reaches far and the maritime lands are tranquil.

sentences.zh: 十二章緬甸來庭，寵膺綸詔。

translations.literal: Chapter Thirteen: Burma comes to court; favored, it receives the imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Thirteen: Burma comes to court; favored, it receives the imperial edict.

translations.literal: Seals are issued and investiture bestowed; forever pacifying the fiery frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Seals are issued and investiture bestowed; forever pacifying the southern frontier.

sentences.zh: 十三章生番鄉化，傾心太平。

translations.literal: Chapter Fourteen: Raw tribes in the countryside are transformed; they devote their hearts to great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fourteen: Frontier tribes are transformed; they devote their hearts to great peace.

translations.literal: Grace soaks marrow and flesh; awesomeness and reverence are all sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Grace soaks to the marrow; awe and reverence are all sincerity.

sentences.zh: 十四章聖明四照，福綏綿綿。

translations.literal: Chapter Fifteen: Sage illumination shines on four sides; blessing and peace extend without end.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Fifteen: Sage illumination shines on every side; blessing and peace extend without end.

translations.literal: Auspicious omens repeatedly arrive; for a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious omens arrive again and again; for endless ages.

sentences.zh: 十五章永承天庥，祥徵滋至。

translations.literal: Chapter Sixteen: Forever receiving Heaven's protection; auspicious signs ever increase.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Sixteen: Forever receiving Heaven's protection; auspicious signs ever increase.

translations.literal: They chant the ninefold blessings; the throne's fortune extends for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: They chant the ninefold blessings; the throne's fortune extends for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 十六章子孫曾玄戲采舞，壽而康兮祝純嘏。

translations.literal: Chapter Seventeen: Sons, grandsons, great-grandsons and great-great-grandsons perform the colorful dance; long life and health, they pray for pure blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seventeen: Sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons perform the colorful dance; long life and health, they pray for pure blessing.

sentences.zh: 歲歲年年福履增，天地合德同博溥。

translations.literal: Year after year fortune's path increases; heaven and earth combine in virtue, alike vast and wide.
translations.idiomatic: Year after year fortune's path increases; heaven and earth combine in virtue, vast and wide alike.

sentences.zh: 十七章中和舞樂邁韶韺，普天率土歡同聲。

translations.literal: Chapter Eighteen: The Zhonghe dance music surpasses the Shao; throughout heaven and every land within, joy is one voice.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eighteen: The Zhonghe dance music surpasses the Shao; all under heaven share one voice of joy.

sentences.zh: 慶萬壽兮茀祿膺，受天佑兮莫不承。

translations.literal: Celebrating ten thousand years of longevity, abundant fortune is received; receiving Heaven's aid, none fail to bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Celebrating long life, abundant fortune is received; receiving Heaven's aid, none fail to bear it.

translations.literal: Chapter Eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eighteen.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十四年，仁宗五旬萬壽，慶隆舞樂九章

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiaqing, for the Renzong Emperor's fiftieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance music has nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 14, for the Renzong Emperor's fiftieth Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 皇帝萬萬壽，壽與天無疆。

translations.literal: The Emperor's ten thousand myriad years of longevity; longevity boundless as heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand myriad years to the Emperor; longevity boundless as heaven.

sentences.zh: 秉德貞恆篤鴻祜，珍符曼羨恩滂洋。

translations.literal: Upholding virtue with steadfast constancy, he receives vast blessing; precious signs are abundant and grace floods like waves.
translations.idiomatic: Upholding virtue with steadfast constancy, he receives vast blessing; precious omens abound and grace floods like waves.

sentences.zh: 一章歲維己巳，聖節五旬。

translations.literal: Chapter One: The year is jisi; the sacred festival marks five decades.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: In the jisi year the sacred festival marks five decades.

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The six directions flourish and prosper; spring sunshine beams brightly.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The six directions flourish and prosper; spring sunshine beams brightly.

sentences.zh: 二章我皇功德冒八極，埽除群慝登袵席。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: Our Emperor's merit and virtue cover the eight poles; sweeping away all evils, he ascends the throne of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: Our Emperor's merit and virtue cover the eight directions; sweeping away all evils, he ascends the throne of peace.

sentences.zh: 磑磑即即師象山，永綏生民偃兵革。

translations.literal: Steadfastly he takes Xiangshan as his teacher; forever he pacifies the people and lays down arms.
translations.idiomatic: Steadfastly he takes the sages as his model; forever he pacifies the people and lays down arms.

translations.literal: Chapter Four: The people's livelihood is secured; primal transformation moistens all.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: The people's livelihood is secured; primal transformation moistens all.

translations.literal: He checks decline and shrinkage; he widens relief for the orphaned and destitute.
translations.idiomatic: He checks decline and shrinkage; he widens relief for the orphaned and destitute.

translations.literal: They are filled with meals and gruel; they inherit robes and padded garments.
translations.idiomatic: They are filled with meals and gruel; they inherit robes and padded garments.

translations.literal: They rejoice in brightness and ease; they rest in comfort and delight.
translations.idiomatic: They rejoice in brightness and ease; they rest in comfort and delight.

translations.literal: Chapter Five: He is their ruler, he is their teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: He is their ruler, he is their teacher.

translations.literal: Great is his tolerance and protection; he spreads teaching and thought.
translations.idiomatic: Great is his tolerance and protection; he spreads teaching and thought.

translations.literal: None is thicker than his instruction of the imperial clans.
translations.idiomatic: None is thicker than his instruction of the imperial clans.

translations.literal: None is more benevolent than his admonition to the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: None is more benevolent than his admonition to the Eight Banners.

sentences.zh: 五章繼統恭勤兮儉德先，有孚惠心兮靡回延。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: Inheriting the throne with reverent diligence, frugal virtue comes first; with sincere and gracious heart, never turning back or delaying.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: Inheriting the throne with reverent diligence, frugal virtue comes first; with sincere and gracious heart, never turning back.

sentences.zh: 泉府充羨兮軫民艱，馮蠵輯和兮功濬川。

translations.literal: The treasury is full and abundant, mindful of the people's hardship; the great tortoise gathers harmony, his achievement dredging the rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The treasury is full, mindful of the people's hardship; harmony is gathered, his achievement dredging the rivers.

sentences.zh: 六章重民耕織，雨暘寒燠。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: He values the people's farming and weaving; rain, sunshine, cold, and heat are timely.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: He values the people's farming and weaving; rain, sunshine, cold, and heat are timely.

translations.literal: He compiles illustrations for presenting garments; he collates records of his ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: He compiles illustrations for presenting garments; he collates records of his ancestors.

translations.literal: Great filial piety is complete; nurturing the people is the treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Great filial piety is complete; nurturing the people is the treasure.

sentences.zh: 七章辟公卿士，俊髦龐蒙。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: Dukes, ministers, and scholars; eminent talents and venerable elders.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: Dukes, ministers, and scholars; eminent talents and venerable elders.

translations.literal: Clouds bestow, mountains respond; descending blessing repeatedly flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds bestow, mountains respond; descending blessing repeatedly flourishes.

translations.literal: Melon vines extend without end; above, the imperial heart is pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Melon vines extend without end; above, the imperial heart is pleased.

sentences.zh: 八章承昊佑兮撫八紘，洪景命兮方升恆。

translations.literal: Chapter Nine: Receiving Heaven's aid, he governs the eight cords; great mandate and splendid fortune now rise ever higher.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Nine: Receiving Heaven's aid, he governs every border; great mandate and splendid fortune now rise ever higher.

sentences.zh: 率土臚歡兮，重譯職貢，於萬斯年兮，福祿永膺。

translations.literal: Throughout the land proclaimed joy; through many translations tribute is presented; for ten thousand years, fortune and blessing forever received.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the land proclaimed joy; through many tongues tribute is presented; for ten thousand years, fortune and blessing forever received.

translations.literal: Nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十四年，仁宗六旬萬壽，慶隆舞樂九章

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing, for the Renzong Emperor's sixtieth-birthday Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance music has nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 24, for the Renzong Emperor's sixtieth Longevity celebration, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 九有嘉吉萬匯昌，貞冬嫗煦日載陽。

translations.literal: The nine regions have auspicious fortune; myriad blessings flourish; in the true winter the nurturing warmth daily loads with yang.
translations.idiomatic: The nine regions have auspicious fortune; myriad blessings flourish; in true winter nurturing warmth daily loads with yang.

sentences.zh: 帝承昊貺錫兆庶，聖壽曼羨長無疆。

translations.literal: The Emperor receives Heaven's gift and bestows it on the myriad people; sage longevity is abundant and long without bound.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor receives Heaven's gift and bestows it on the people; sage longevity is abundant and long without bound.

sentences.zh: 一章十幹十二枝，紀歲周復始。

translations.literal: Chapter One: The ten stems and twelve branches mark the year's cycle returning to its start.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: The ten stems and twelve branches mark the year's cycle returning to its start.

sentences.zh: 皇帝壽齊天，循環萬甲子。

translations.literal: The Emperor's longevity equals heaven; the cycle turns for ten thousand jiazi.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's longevity equals heaven; the cycle turns for ten thousand jiazi.

sentences.zh: 二章北暨窮髮南雕題，耕桑直過崑崙西。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: North to the uttermost fringe, south to the carved foreheads; plowing and sericulture extend straight past Kunlun to the west.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: North to the uttermost fringe, south to the carved foreheads; farming extends straight past Kunlun to the west.

sentences.zh: 黃河安恬日東注，波澄鏡海騰朝曦。

translations.literal: The Yellow River is tranquil day by day flowing east; waves clear, the mirror sea reflects the morning sun.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River is tranquil day by day flowing east; waves clear, the mirror sea reflects the morning sun.

sentences.zh: 三章景風翔兮卿雲升，民游壽宇兮化日恆。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: Auspicious winds soar; auspicious clouds rise; the people roam the realm of longevity; transforming sun is constant.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: Auspicious winds soar; auspicious clouds rise; the people roam the realm of longevity; the transforming sun is constant.

sentences.zh: 世龐鴻兮多耇耋，生逢太平兮由高曾。

translations.literal: The age is vast and grand; many reach venerable age; born in great peace, from high ancestors onward.
translations.idiomatic: The age is vast and grand; many reach venerable age; born in great peace, from high ancestors onward.

translations.literal: Chapter Four: Thick is the people's livelihood; he examines their faults.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: Thick is the people's livelihood; he examines their faults.

translations.literal: He establishes fine grain; weeds and tares are uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: He establishes fine grain; weeds and tares are uprooted.

translations.literal: He honors correct teaching; shame and reform are achieved.
translations.idiomatic: He honors correct teaching; shame and reform are achieved.

translations.literal: He favors the masses; the Emperor's virtue is everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: He favors the masses; the Emperor's virtue is everywhere.

sentences.zh: 五章繼皇統兮承祖澤，王業艱難兮孝思靡極。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: Inheriting the imperial line, receiving ancestral grace; royal enterprise was arduous, filial thought without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: Inheriting the imperial line, receiving ancestral grace; royal enterprise was arduous, filial thought without limit.

sentences.zh: 眷遼瀋兮夙法駕，式考訓兮永無斁。

translations.literal: Cherishing Liaodong, long ago the imperial carriage; following the lessons, never weary.
translations.idiomatic: Cherishing Liaodong, long ago the imperial carriage; following the lessons, never weary.

sentences.zh: 六章帝廑烝民，拯之德政。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: The Emperor labors for the myriad people; saving them is his virtuous policy.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: The Emperor labors for the myriad people; saving them is his virtuous policy.

translations.literal: Whether rain or sunshine, Heaven's heart responds in accord.
translations.idiomatic: Whether rain or sunshine, Heaven's heart responds in accord.

translations.literal: Joyful is the spring terrace; abundant years repeatedly celebrate.
translations.idiomatic: Joyful is the spring terrace; abundant years repeatedly celebrate.

sentences.zh: 七章日月方升恆，川岳咸效順。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Sun and moon now rise ever higher; rivers and peaks all effect submission.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: Sun and moon now rise ever higher; rivers and peaks all effect submission.

sentences.zh: 祝嘏萬方同，梯航集琛贐。

translations.literal: Blessings offered from the myriad regions are the same; ladders and ships gather precious tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings offered from every land are the same; ladders and ships gather precious tribute.

sentences.zh: 八章歲己巳兮恩普錫，今茲己卯兮六旬聖節。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: In the jisi year grace was universally bestowed; now in this jimao year, the sixtieth-birthday sacred festival.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: In the jisi year grace was universally bestowed; now in this jimao year, the sixtieth sacred festival.

sentences.zh: 帝澤汪濊兮，海樂康，原逢旬慶兮萬有千億。

translations.literal: Imperial favor is vast and overflowing; the sea rejoices in peace; we pray to meet the decadal celebration, ten thousand beings, a thousand hundred million.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial favor overflows; the sea rejoices in peace; we pray to meet the decadal celebration, for all creation beyond count.

translations.literal: Nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十八年，乾清宮普宴宗親，世德舞樂九章

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Qianlong, at the Qianqing Palace universal banquet for imperial clansmen, the Shide dance music has nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 48, at the Qianqing Palace universal banquet for imperial clansmen, the Shide dance was performed to music in nine chapters.

translations.literal: Heaven opened the sacred Qing; the Aisin Gioro first arose.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven opened the sacred Qing; the Aisin Gioro first arose.

translations.literal: Successive ancestors continued the thread; unifying the realm within the seas.
translations.idiomatic: Successive ancestors continued the thread; unifying the realm within the seas.

sentences.zh: 一章溯祥長白，垂統發跡。

translations.literal: Chapter One: Tracing auspiciousness from Changbai, the line was transmitted and footprints set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: Tracing auspiciousness from Changbai, the line was transmitted and the dynasty set forth.

translations.literal: Territory vast and great; all draw near in joy and pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: Territory vast and great; all draw near in joy and pleasure.

sentences.zh: 二章聖皇立極，與天比崇。

translations.literal: Chapter Two: The sage Emperor established the pole; he is compared in height to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Two: The sage Emperor established the pole; he is compared in height to Heaven.

translations.literal: Pure constancy and abundant fortune; flourishing posterity and exalted clans.
translations.idiomatic: Pure constancy and abundant fortune; flourishing posterity and exalted clans.

sentences.zh: 三章篤親九族，錫恩單厚。

translations.literal: Chapter Three: Deep affection for the nine clans; grace bestowed singularly thick.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: Deep affection for the nine clans; grace bestowed singularly thick.

translations.literal: Golden yellow belt hangs down; lofty caps and ranks are conferred.
translations.idiomatic: Golden yellow belt hangs down; lofty caps and ranks are conferred.

sentences.zh: 四章枝蕃萼榮，皇情則怡。

translations.literal: Chapter Four: Branches flourish, calyxes bloom; the imperial heart is then pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: Branches flourish, calyxes bloom; the imperial heart is then pleased.

translations.literal: Fine reception of Heaven's harmony; in spring the year loads with brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Fine reception of Heaven's harmony; in spring the year loads with brightness.

sentences.zh: 五章璇宮肆筵，宗人爰集。

translations.literal: Chapter Five: At the jade palace the banquet is spread; clansmen gather.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: At the jade palace the banquet is spread; clansmen gather.

translations.literal: Embroidered emblems fill the court; ranks and rows are distinguished in order.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered emblems fill the court; ranks and rows are distinguished in order.

sentences.zh: 六章皇睠有喜，便蕃賚予。

translations.literal: Chapter Six: The imperial gaze has joy; gifts are frequently bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Six: The imperial gaze has joy; gifts are frequently bestowed.

translations.literal: Attendants are granted tea; grace encompasses dew-like moisture.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants are granted tea; grace encompasses dew-like moisture.

sentences.zh: 七章肫仁溥澤，大府頒金。

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Sincere benevolence and universal favor; the great treasury distributes gold.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: Sincere benevolence and universal favor; the great treasury distributes gold.

translations.literal: Imperial compassion is already deep; thereby the multitude of clansmen is harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial compassion is already deep; thereby the clansmen are harmonized.

sentences.zh: 八章宗人拜舞，臚歡忭祝。

translations.literal: Chapter Eight: Clansmen bow and dance; proclaimed joy and congratulatory prayer.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: Clansmen bow and dance; proclaimed joy and congratulatory prayer.

translations.literal: For a hundred million years, forever pacified with many blessings.
translations.idiomatic: For endless ages, forever pacified with many blessings.

translations.literal: Nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Nine chapters.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，巡幸盛京，筵宴，慶隆舞樂一章

translations.literal: In early Qianlong, on the imperial tour to Shengjing, at the banquet, the Qinglong dance music has one chapter.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong, on the imperial tour to Shengjing, at the banquet, the Qinglong dance was performed to music in one chapter.

translations.literal: Heaven's bright mandate; sincerely the Taizu was born.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's bright mandate; sincerely the Taizu was born.

translations.literal: Granted sage wisdom; he covered the eastern lands.
translations.idiomatic: Granted sage wisdom; he covered the eastern lands.

translations.literal: Of the sage Taizu, he founded the base and created the enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Of the sage Taizu, he founded the base and created the enterprise.

translations.literal: He first devised the national script; one writing for the six harmonies.
translations.idiomatic: He first devised the national script; one writing for the six harmonies.

translations.literal: Thus like the Taizong, he succeeded and received Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Thus like the Taizong, he succeeded and received Heaven's mandate.

translations.literal: He first created the central realm; nurturing with benevolence, governing with righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: He first created the central realm; nurturing with benevolence, governing with righteousness.

translations.literal: The Taizong is like Heaven; greatly he covers with pure virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizong is like Heaven; greatly he covers all with pure virtue.

translations.literal: Illustrious is great Qing; earnestly it established the imperial pinnacle.
translations.idiomatic: Illustrious is great Qing; earnestly it established the imperial pinnacle.

translations.literal: Rising Capital then rose; Prosperous Capital thereby flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Rising Capital rose anew; Prosperous Capital flourished in turn.

translations.literal: Only through utmost benevolence were the nine regions entrusted with the mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Through utmost benevolence alone, the nine regions entrusted him with the mandate.

translations.literal: Reverently the sage emperor, in yearning remembrance deeply reflected.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently the sage emperor yearned and reflected in deep remembrance.

translations.literal: Following the ancestors' paths, he blessed our worthy army.
translations.idiomatic: Following the ways of his ancestors, he blessed our worthy armies.

translations.literal: Reverently viewing the veritable records, sun and stars serve as his glory.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently reading the veritable records, his glory shines like sun and stars.

translations.literal: The ancestral enterprise was arduous; at heart he was deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral enterprise was arduous; at heart he was deeply troubled.

translations.literal: Then he issued a bright edict, proclaiming it to officials and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Then he issued a clear edict, proclaiming it to officials and people alike.

translations.literal: Reverently he visited the ancestral tombs, then turned his carriage toward the accompanying capital.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently he visited the ancestral tombs, then turned toward Mukden.

translations.literal: The emperor's steadfast sincerity; at the pearl mound he paid his respects.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor showed steadfast sincerity; at the imperial tombs he paid his respects.

translations.literal: Civil and military attendant ministers rushed in swift loyalty to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military ministers rushed forward in loyal service.

translations.literal: Our emperor is sacred; nothing small or great is overlooked.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor is sacred; nothing small or great escapes his care.

translations.literal: The attendant civil and military ministers, in sympathy and care, are thorough in knowledge.
translations.idiomatic: His civil and military ministers share his sympathy and care in all they know.

translations.literal: Then he passed beyond the border passes; then he traversed Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: Then beyond the border passes; then through Mongolia.

translations.literal: Reviewing the Seven Aimans, the frontier tribes danced in joy.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the Seven Aimans, the frontier tribes danced for joy.

translations.idiomatic: Drowning in this petty joy — ultimate joy is hard to expect.

translations.literal: Zhang Fu: Qian's radiance without partiality; sacred teaching without categories.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu: Qian's radiance without partiality; sacred teaching without categories.

translations.literal: Counsel and instruction vast; mirror this without obscurity.
translations.idiomatic: Counsel and instruction vast; mirror this without obscurity.

sentences.zh: 天馬吟騏驥不群蹇驢，鴻鵠不偕斥鷃。

translations.literal: Heavenly Horse chant: the qiji does not herd with lame donkeys; the swan does not pair with the marsh pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Horse chant: the qiji does not herd with lame donkeys; the swan does not pair with the marsh pheasant.

translations.literal: The zouyu does not approach foxes; the sage does not favor the foolish and base.

translations.literal: Beginning Principles: blessing and wisdom Heaven bestows — truly hard to behold.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning Principles: blessing and wisdom Heaven bestows — truly hard to behold.

translations.literal: Penetrating persons and accomplished scholars — how could they be easily met?
translations.idiomatic: Penetrating persons and accomplished scholars — how could they be easily met?

translations.idiomatic: Tong and Qi; atop the head is a fine topknot.

translations.idiomatic: Worthy ones assist the royal house; do not hold the left path, you locust pests.

translations.idiomatic: Fine words supply my Way; classics and histories enrich my heart.

translations.idiomatic: Not greedy for food and drink — moved by elders' sincere devotion.

translations.idiomatic: Lofty Conduct: how to attain great peace? Gazing at the imperial thoroughfare.

translations.idiomatic: Human life — how constant? Well keep the thousand-gold body.

translations.idiomatic: The people cannot forget; fine name illuminates the spirit realm.

translations.literal: Descendants vibrate the cord; hundreds of millions and more.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants vibrate the cord; hundreds of millions and more.

translations.idiomatic: Chapter Three: Reverently honor the Buddha's command, like moistening sweet rain.

translations.idiomatic: Bees see flowers and stop; dragonflies go fluttering away.

translations.idiomatic: Having tasted every fruit — not like mother's milk, sweet.

translations.idiomatic: Dharma Seat: lightning is fearsome; the season reaches cinnabar brightness.

translations.idiomatic: Frost is fearsome; the five grains are about to ripen.

translations.idiomatic: Calamity is fearsome; joy is what it accomplishes.

translations.idiomatic: None is not fearsome; recalling the spirit-soul's first birth.

translations.idiomatic: Guidance: the house of fire has no cool shade; the bitter road has no peace and joy.

translations.idiomatic: Transformation Guidance: Jambudvipa realm, like that high mountain — crossing it is hard.

translations.idiomatic: Exhausting the present time; the great sea is vast — wishing to cross is truly hard.

translations.idiomatic: Seven Treasures Saddle: gazing at that embankment; water then does not overflow.

translations.idiomatic: Having a lord shepherding the people — there should be no rebellion and scattering.

translations.idiomatic: Though birds are weary, they would rather fall to earth.

translations.idiomatic: Short Song: Alas for the joy of remaining life — like the yellow orb's fullness and slant.

translations.idiomatic: Feeling the glorious light's passing — like green upon the leaf.

translations.idiomatic: When flowering glory is at the teeth — for now rejoice and forever daily.

translations.idiomatic: The hour already passes — what share joy with?

translations.literal: The yellow orb already slants; surely little warm geniality.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow orb already slants; surely little warm geniality.

translations.literal: Heaven's light already dusk; dim and dim its shade.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's light already dusk; dim and dim its shade.

translations.idiomatic: Homeland Ballad: august is the sage era; gentle as the benevolent lord.

translations.idiomatic: Longing, longing; day distant, day parted.

translations.idiomatic: Day distant, day parted — cannot gaze afar and stand on tiptoe.

translations.idiomatic: Monastic Treasure chant: offering sincerity, taking refuge — already peaceful and auspicious.

translations.idiomatic: Like a Buddha pagoda-temple — why so far separate?

translations.literal: Like elder sister, like younger sister — why so far separate?
translations.idiomatic: Like elder sister, like younger sister — why so far separate?

translations.idiomatic: Brahman Introduction: curd must become ghee; father will become grandfather.

translations.idiomatic: Sand must become hill; mother will become old woman.

translations.idiomatic: Three Tribes: try viewing the three realms — bubbles rise, bubbles perish.

translations.literal: Like those autumn clouds, now rising, now sinking.
translations.idiomatic: Like those autumn clouds, now rising, now sinking.

translations.idiomatic: Five Tribes: flowing water how surging — my life is like this wandering.

translations.literal: Though there are sage and worthy men — who can slightly linger?
translations.idiomatic: Though there are sage and worthy men — who can slightly linger?

translations.idiomatic: The celestial gate is brilliant; bells and chimes ring clearly.

translations.idiomatic: The whip sounds; reverently solemn — the emperor thereby feasts in peace.

translations.idiomatic: Bearing Heaven's pure blessing; ancestral virtue congeals as shelter.

translations.idiomatic: With composure settling and fixing; truly ascending the great design.

translations.idiomatic: Sacred virtue broadly spread; light covers the distant and near.

translations.idiomatic: Towering is the flourishing virtue; for a hundred million years.

translations.idiomatic: Illustrious is imperial awesomeness; displayed through the nine domains.

translations.idiomatic: Chapter One: There is the cut-off Hui frontier; the Pure Emperor pacified it.

translations.literal: Revering the spirits and accepting teaching; securing our frontier fence.
translations.idiomatic: Revering the spirits and accepting teaching; securing our frontier fence.

translations.idiomatic: The prairie fire burns itself; law cannot pardon.

translations.idiomatic: Chapter Four: The four cities already governed; the ugly faction already leveled.

translations.idiomatic: The bow-case unstrung and spread; where does the demon bird rest?

translations.idiomatic: Chapter Five: The Hui villages yearly approach; owls gather and stop.

translations.literal: Chapter Seven: Of old was assigned the expedition chariot; now is sung gathering ferns.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter Seven: Of old was assigned the expedition chariot; now is sung gathering ferns.

translations.idiomatic: Receiving blessing from Heaven's ancestor; returning grace to the kind empress dowager.

translations.idiomatic: Chapter Eight: Fine offerings are fitting rites; broad is the grace bestowed.

translations.literal: At heart beloved and supported; bowing the head, coming as subject.
translations.idiomatic: At heart beloved and supported; bowing the head, coming as subject.

sentences.zh: 念人生之無常兮，合勤修夫善行。

translations.literal: Thinking that human life is without constancy — together diligently cultivate good conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking that human life is without constancy — together diligently cultivate good conduct.

sentences.zh: 信百行之咸善兮，終和平而神聽。

translations.literal: Trusting that the hundred conduct are all good — in the end peaceful, and the spirits listen.
translations.idiomatic: Trusting that the hundred conduct are all good — in the end peaceful, and the spirits listen.

sentences.zh: 染絲曲大君至聖，教敷率土。

translations.literal: Dyed Silk Tune: the great lord is supremely sage; teaching spreads through the land.
translations.idiomatic: Dyed Silk Tune: the great lord is supremely sage; teaching spreads through the land.

translations.literal: Pacifying the myriad states; bowing and kneeling, serving the lord.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying the myriad states; bowing and kneeling, serving the lord.

sentences.zh: 公莫丕顯元後，惠懷萬方。

translations.literal: Gong Mo: illustrious is the primordial sovereign; favoring and cherishing the ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Mo: illustrious is the primordial sovereign; favoring and cherishing the ten thousand regions.

translations.literal: National outstanding talents respectful; jointly assisting state constants.
translations.idiomatic: National outstanding talents respectful; jointly assisting state constants.

translations.literal: Along the land's margin; sincerity broadly spread.
translations.idiomatic: Along the land's margin; sincerity broadly spread.

translations.literal: All bow and kowtow; relying on and supporting the sage emperor.
translations.idiomatic: All bow and kowtow; relying on and supporting the sage emperor.

sentences.zh: 雅政辭皇皇聖明，無遠弗燭。

translations.literal: Elegant Governance Words: august and sage-bright; nothing distant is not illumined.
translations.idiomatic: Elegant Governance Words: august and sage-bright; nothing distant is not illumined.

translations.literal: Numerous are the multitude; no thought but submission.
translations.idiomatic: Numerous are the multitude; no thought but submission.

translations.literal: Primary transformation and favoring heart — doing good, removing evil.
translations.idiomatic: Primary transformation and favoring heart — doing good, removing evil.

translations.literal: The sage person's domain — long life, eternal joy.
translations.idiomatic: The sage person's domain — long life, eternal joy.

sentences.zh: 鳳凰鳴承乾體元，惟我聖君。

translations.literal: Phoenix Cry: receiving Qian's substance and origin — only our sage lord.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix Cry: receiving Qian's substance and origin — only our sage lord.

translations.literal: Light opening the grass wilderness — only our sage lord.
translations.idiomatic: Light opening the grass wilderness — only our sage lord.

translations.literal: Discipline and regulation of myriad government — only our sage lord.
translations.idiomatic: Discipline and regulation of myriad government — only our sage lord.

translations.literal: Father and mother to ten thousand states — only our sage lord.
translations.idiomatic: Father and mother to ten thousand states — only our sage lord.

translations.literal: Only our sage lord — covering and shielding like heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Only our sage lord — covering and shielding like heaven.

translations.literal: Only our sage lord — renewing himself, renewing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Only our sage lord — renewing himself, renewing the people.

translations.literal: Only our sage lord — within and without all peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Only our sage lord — within and without all peaceful.

translations.literal: Only our sage lord — all wickedness dissolves and sinks.
translations.idiomatic: Only our sage lord — all wickedness dissolves and sinks.

translations.literal: Bow the hand, kowtow — praise overflows the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: Bow the hand, kowtow — praise overflows the myriad people.

sentences.zh: 乘驛使大地茫茫，大海滄滄。

translations.literal: Riding the Courier: the great earth vast and boundless; the great sea vast and blue.
translations.idiomatic: Riding the Courier: the great earth vast and boundless; the great sea vast and blue.

translations.literal: How could there be no treasure? Seeking it — which direction?
translations.idiomatic: How could there be no treasure? Seeking it — which direction?

translations.literal: From antiquity in the past — to be lord, to be king.
translations.idiomatic: From antiquity in the past — to be lord, to be king.

translations.literal: Receiving the chart, ruling the realm — mandate not of constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the chart, ruling the realm — mandate not of constancy.

translations.literal: Solid heart, solid government — favoring this ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: Solid heart, solid government — favoring this ten thousand regions.

translations.literal: Sacredly holding the great treasure — only our emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Sacredly holding the great treasure — only our emperor.

sentences.zh: 繄惟我皇兮，疇可與之頡頏。

translations.literal: Only our emperor — who can match strides with him?
translations.idiomatic: Only our emperor — who can match strides with him?

sentences.zh: 回部樂曲一章律呂后編回部樂曲國書用漢對音而旁註宮譜，今以漢對音載其辭。

translations.literal: Hui Frontier Music: one chapter — pitch and mode later compiled; Hui frontier music uses national script with Han transliteration and palace scores noted at the side; now the Han transliteration carries the lyrics.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Frontier Music: one chapter — pitch and mode later compiled; Hui frontier music uses the national script with Han transliteration and palace scores noted at the side; now the Han transliteration carries the lyrics.

sentences.zh: 思那滿塞勒喀思，察罕珠魯塞勒喀思。

translations.literal: Transliteration (Manchu): "Sini man salar kasi, Chahan jur salar kasi."
translations.idiomatic: Your banner is blessed; the White Banner is blessed.
